title: Sr. Developer Advocate, Open Source — Omnigent
descriptionHtml:
RDQ327R182

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's most challenging problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI platform, enabling our customers to use deep data insights to improve their businesses. Our ability to execute this mission depends on building trust and recognition within an ever-growing community of data engineers, analysts, scientists, machine learning practitioners, and AI practitioners.

Are you a Developer Advocate who thrives in the spotlight, loves presenting and hosting events, and is genuinely hands-on with agentic developer tooling — the kind of person who has already wired up three coding agents and has opinions about what breaks?

As a Senior Developer Advocate for Omnigent, you'll be a vital bridge between our engineering teams and the open source community forming around Omnigent, our meta-harness for AI agents. Omnigent sits one level above harnesses like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Pi, giving developers a common interface to compose agents, govern them with contextual policies, sandboxing, and cost controls, and collaborate on live sessions from any device. Your focus is squarely on the open source project and the community around it: templates, demos, and reference implementations that developers can clone, fork, and extend, and the contributors who will help the project grow beyond us.

This is a build-the-community role. Omnigent is early, and the people who adopt it now will shape what it becomes. You'll help developers integrate it into their own stacks, make it easy for new contributors to land their first pull request, and create the kind of momentum where the project's best advocates are people who don't work here.

Your responsibilities will encompass a wide range of knowledge-sharing activities. You'll deliver engaging talks, host panels and meetups, create blogs and video content, build courseware and sample repositories, answer questions in community forums and issue trackers, and meet one-on-one with influential practitioners.

Reporting to the Head of Developer Relations, you'll collaborate with fellow Developer Advocates and program managers to create and execute a cohesive and impactful open source strategy.

The ideal candidate embodies the values of our Developer Relations team: a deep passion for data and AI, genuine empathy for developers' needs, and the ability to explain complex ideas clearly and responsibly.

More about the DevRel team

The Developer Relations (DevRel) team at Databricks is dedicated to building and fostering relationships with communities of data practitioners. Our goal is to drive awareness and adoption of the Databricks Data + AI Platform — including Lakeflow, Lakebase, Genie Agents, and AI/BI — alongside the open source projects that underpin it, such as Apache Spark™, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Apache Iceberg™, and Omnigent. Our team also owns programs like the Databricks MVP program, the user group program, and DevConnect roadshows.

The impact you will have

  • Own medium-to-large advocacy projects end-to-end for Omnigent, from scoping through delivery.
  • Grow the Omnigent contributor community: lower the barrier to a first contribution, review and triage in the open, and help new maintainers take on real responsibility.
  • Drive external adoption by showing developers how to integrate Omnigent into their existing agent stacks and their own products — including stacks that have nothing to do with Databricks.
  • Create practical templates, sample repositories, and reference implementations that developers can clone, fork, and ship.
  • Create high-quality educational content — videos, tutorials, courseware, and blog posts — covering harness composition, contextual policies, sandboxing, and cost controls, and reuse each core asset across formats.
  • Drive awareness and adoption of Omnigent through speaking engagements at industry events, conferences, and meetups.
  • Act as a trusted advisor between the community and our engineering team, and influence roadmap discussions with what you learn.
  • Support developers where they already are — GitHub issues, Discord, Slack, Stack Overflow, and Reddit — and keep a real pulse on what's blocking them.
  • Mentor and unblock less-experienced advocates in content, demos, and public speaking.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of combined experience as a developer advocate and in a hands-on technical role — software engineer, ML engineer, or solutions architect.
  • Professional experience actually building software, and current hands-on experience with agentic developer tooling and coding agents.
  • Strong Python and TypeScript skills, and comfort at the command line and in other people's codebases.
  • Demonstrated experience contributing to open source projects and working in the open — issues, pull requests, reviews, and release processes.
  • Subject matter knowledge of agent architecture, orchestration, sandboxing, and the practical problems of running agents safely and affordably.
  • Experience growing a contributor community, not just a user base.
  • Active participation and recognized leadership in open source community forums, chats, and meetups — measured by what the community builds with your help, not by follower count.
  • A public portfolio of technical work: repositories, tutorials, talks, or sustained community contributions.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with a talent for articulating complex concepts through writing, teaching, video, and public speaking.
  • Deep empathy for developer needs, with the ability to craft engaging experiences across tutorials, sample projects, and community platforms.
  • Adept at collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to align community initiatives with product objectives.

descriptionHtml:

Databricks’ Developer Relations team is looking for a leader to manage our open source Developer Advocates, deepen our engagement across the Apache Software Foundation and Linux Foundation communities, and lead technical storytelling and experiences that strengthen trust and adoption. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in the spotlight, is known and respected in open source communities, and gets even more satisfaction from growing other advocates than from giving the keynote themselves.

As the Developer Advocate Manager for Open Source, you'll lead the team that advocates for the projects Databricks builds in the open, and serve as a crucial link between our engineering teams and the global community of practitioners building their careers on them. Your team's remit spans the Open Lakehouse — Apache Spark™ (including Spark Declarative Pipelines), Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Apache Iceberg™, and MLflow — as well as Omnigent, our open source meta-harness for composing, governing, and sharing AI agents. As the original creators of Apache Spark™, Delta Lake, and MLflow, we hold ourselves to a high standard here: our credibility in these communities is earned continuously, not inherited.

This role will leverage your expertise in building and scaling a developer relations team, and it will build on your standing within the open source world and your working relationships with the Apache Software Foundation, the Linux Foundation, and the maintainers and committers who keep these projects healthy. You'll coach your team on building a content flywheel — where a single demo, video, or talk becomes the source of truth for a dozen derivative assets — and on applying AI as a force multiplier without ever lowering the technical bar.

Your responsibilities will encompass both team leadership and a wide range of knowledge-sharing activities. You'll lead by example: delivering engaging talks, hosting panels and meetups, creating blogs and video content, developing courseware, answering questions in community forums, and meeting one-on-one with influential contributors and maintainers.

Community engagement will be at the heart of your role. You'll work closely with the open source communities and with product and engineering teams, ensuring that community needs and product development align seamlessly. Reporting directly to the Head of Developer Relations, you'll collaborate with fellow DevRel managers across our Databricks, App Dev, and DevRel Programs teams to create a cohesive and impactful open source strategy.

As an Senior Manager, Field Engineering, you will lead a broader team of technical customer advisors and help shape the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for a significant Field Engineering portfolio.   • Set team strategy and roadmaps that connect customer needs, technical priorities, business outcomes, and broader Field Engineering goals.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and use customer, market, and competitive insight to improve account and portfolio strategy.
  • Establish repeatable inspection mechanisms across teams, including portfolio reviews, customer-health reviews, technical-risk reviews, and escalation processes.
  • Coach leaders and senior practitioners through complex customer, technical, competitive, organizational, and performance situations.
  • Build and share playbooks, tools, enablement, and operating mechanisms that increase productivity and consistency beyond one team.

title: Sr. Developer Advocate, Open Source — Omnigent
descriptionHtml:
RDQ327R182

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's most challenging problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI platform, enabling our customers to use deep data insights to improve their businesses. Our ability to execute this mission depends on building trust and recognition within an ever-growing community of data engineers, analysts, scientists, machine learning practitioners, and AI practitioners.

Are you a Developer Advocate who thrives in the spotlight, loves presenting and hosting events, and is genuinely hands-on with agentic developer tooling — the kind of person who has already wired up three coding agents and has opinions about what breaks?

As a Senior Developer Advocate for Omnigent, you'll be a vital bridge between our engineering teams and the open source community forming around Omnigent, our meta-harness for AI agents. Omnigent sits one level above harnesses like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Pi, giving developers a common interface to compose agents, govern them with contextual policies, sandboxing, and cost controls, and collaborate on live sessions from any device. Your focus is squarely on the open source project and the community around it: templates, demos, and reference implementations that developers can clone, fork, and extend, and the contributors who will help the project grow beyond us.

This is a build-the-community role. Omnigent is early, and the people who adopt it now will shape what it becomes. You'll help developers integrate it into their own stacks, make it easy for new contributors to land their first pull request, and create the kind of momentum where the project's best advocates are people who don't work here.

Your responsibilities will encompass a wide range of knowledge-sharing activities. You'll deliver engaging talks, host panels and meetups, create blogs and video content, build courseware and sample repositories, answer questions in community forums and issue trackers, and meet one-on-one with influential practitioners.

Reporting to the Head of Developer Relations, you'll collaborate with fellow Developer Advocates and program managers to create and execute a cohesive and impactful open source strategy.

The ideal candidate embodies the values of our Developer Relations team: a deep passion for data and AI, genuine empathy for developers' needs, and the ability to explain complex ideas clearly and responsibly.

More about the DevRel team

The Developer Relations (DevRel) team at Databricks is dedicated to building and fostering relationships with communities of data practitioners. Our goal is to drive awareness and adoption of the Databricks Data + AI Platform — including Lakeflow, Lakebase, Genie Agents, and AI/BI — alongside the open source projects that underpin it, such as Apache Spark™, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Apache Iceberg™, and Omnigent. Our team also owns programs like the Databricks MVP program, the user group program, and DevConnect roadshows.

The impact you will have

  • Own medium-to-large advocacy projects end-to-end for Omnigent, from scoping through delivery.
  • Grow the Omnigent contributor community: lower the barrier to a first contribution, review and triage in the open, and help new maintainers take on real responsibility.
  • Drive external adoption by showing developers how to integrate Omnigent into their existing agent stacks and their own products — including stacks that have nothing to do with Databricks.
  • Create practical templates, sample repositories, and reference implementations that developers can clone, fork, and ship.
  • Create high-quality educational content — videos, tutorials, courseware, and blog posts — covering harness composition, contextual policies, sandboxing, and cost controls, and reuse each core asset across formats.
  • Drive awareness and adoption of Omnigent through speaking engagements at industry events, conferences, and meetups.
  • Act as a trusted advisor between the community and our engineering team, and influence roadmap discussions with what you learn.
  • Support developers where they already are — GitHub issues, Discord, Slack, Stack Overflow, and Reddit — and keep a real pulse on what's blocking them.
  • Mentor and unblock less-experienced advocates in content, demos, and public speaking.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of combined experience as a developer advocate and in a hands-on technical role — software engineer, ML engineer, or solutions architect.
  • Professional experience actually building software, and current hands-on experience with agentic developer tooling and coding agents.
  • Strong Python and TypeScript skills, and comfort at the command line and in other people's codebases.
  • Demonstrated experience contributing to open source projects and working in the open — issues, pull requests, reviews, and release processes.
  • Subject matter knowledge of agent architecture, orchestration, sandboxing, and the practical problems of running agents safely and affordably.
  • Experience growing a contributor community, not just a user base.
  • Active participation and recognized leadership in open source community forums, chats, and meetups — measured by what the community builds with your help, not by follower count.
  • A public portfolio of technical work: repositories, tutorials, talks, or sustained community contributions.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with a talent for articulating complex concepts through writing, teaching, video, and public speaking.
  • Deep empathy for developer needs, with the ability to craft engaging experiences across tutorials, sample projects, and community platforms.
  • Adept at collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to align community initiatives with product objectives.

title: Specialist Solutions Architect - AI/ML (Healthcare & Life Sciences)
descriptionHtml:
FEQ427R390

As a Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA) on the Healthcare & Life Sciences team, you will help Payers and Providers put generative AI to work at the center of their business. For Payers, that means prior authorization, claims, payment integrity, risk adjustment and the member experience. For Providers, it means clinical documentation, care management, the revenue cycle and the patient experience. Both run on complex, highly regulated data such as EHR records, claims and clinical notes. You will help them turn that data into AI on Databricks that is accurate, governed and ready for production.

In this customer-facing role, you will work with and support Solution Architects, helping customers design and implement essential workloads and shape their roadmap for expanding use of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a go-to expert reporting to the Specialist Field Engineering Manager, you will keep building your skills through mentorship, learning and internal training. You will also deepen a specialty in generative AI, AI agents, Healthcare or another area.

The impact you will have

  • Guide strategic Payer and Provider customers from AI prototype to production, architecting generative AI applications and agents with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuned or open foundation models, and the data platforms behind them
  • Build agents for Payer and Provider workflows such as medical coding, utilization review and member and patient service, including multi-agent systems, tool calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations
  • Apply generative AI to clinical notes, charts, call transcripts and documents for summarization, extraction and chart review
  • Ground AI in governed data through context engineering, semantic layers and natural-language analytics with Genie, so agents answer from trusted business definitions
  • Set up evaluation, tracing and monitoring for AI quality, cost and latency, including LLM judges, human feedback and guardrails, using MLflow
  • Build the data foundations behind AI, including batch and streaming pipelines, data warehouses and migrations from legacy platforms such as Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server, Informatica and SAS
  • Bring machine learning in where it fits, such as risk, fraud and forecasting models that work alongside generative AI and agents
  • Help customers work with healthcare data such as EHR, FHIR, HL7 and claims, and meet HIPAA and PHI requirements through governance with Unity Catalog
  • Use AI tools, including coding assistants and agents, to move quickly from a customer problem to a working prototype and reusable solution accelerators
  • Support Solution Architects on the advanced parts of the technical sale, including custom proof-of-concept content, workload sizing estimates and custom architectures
  • Grow adoption of Databricks with customers and the broader community through tutorials, training, hackathons, blogs and Healthcare conference presentations

What we look for

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, with recent hands-on work building generative AI applications or agents
  • Expertise in generative AI and agents, including LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, tool calling and MCP, prompt and context engineering, fine-tuning, evaluation and guardrails
  • Experience taking AI applications or agents to production to solve business problems, including tracing, evaluation, monitoring, serving and cost control, with tools like MLflow
  • A strong foundation in data engineering, data warehousing or machine learning, such as pipelines and streaming, data modeling and SQL performance, warehouse migrations, model development and MLOps
  • Experience maintaining and extending production data systems as needs grow more complex
  • Comfort using AI coding assistants and agents in day-to-day development and prototyping
  • Production programming experience in SQL and Python, Scala or Java
  • 2 years of hands-on professional experience with big data technologies (such as Spark, Hadoop and Kafka) and architectures
  • 2 years of customer-facing experience in a pre-sales or post-sales role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or Engineering, or equivalent work experience
  • Ability to meet technical training and role-specific expectations within 6 months of hire
  • Ability to travel up to 30% when needed

Preferred qualifications:

  • Education in a healthcare-related field (for example health informatics, biostatistics, epidemiology, public health or health economics), or equivalent experience
  • Experience with Payers or Providers, such as claims, care management, risk adjustment, quality measures, clinical operations, EHR data or revenue cycle management

descriptionHtml:
At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems. Our customers leverage the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to power their mission critical Data and AI applications to improve how their organisations leverage data and insights to make better decisions, faster. Customers rely on Databricks for the full range of data workloads, including data engineering, ETL, near real-time streaming, machine learning, SQL analytics, and advanced analytics.

The Solutions Architect (EDW Migrations) executes on Databricks’ strategic product lines to develop, establish and drive product adoption and product market fit to grow customer adoption across EMEA.   • Develop Programmatic and Scalable Migration Processes: Architect and continuously refine programmatic assets and detailed technical guides that enable field teams and partners to execute migrations.

  • Establish Industry Thought Leadership: Author whitepapers, publish technical blogs, and deliver high-impact presentations at public forums (such as the Data + AI Summit) to position the Databricks Intelligence Platform as the premier platform for enterprise database modernization.
  • Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical environments.

Competencies & Responsibilities

descriptionHtml:
CSQ427R300

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. title: Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
CSQ427R94

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
  • Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
  • Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
  • Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
  • Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
  • Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
  • Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
  • Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for:

  • 6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
  • Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
  • Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
  • Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
  • Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
  • Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
  • Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
  • Documentation and white-boarding skills.
  • Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
  • Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.

title: Specialist Solutions Architect - AWS Infrastructure & AI Platform
descriptionHtml:
FEQ427R143

As anInfrastructure & AI Platform Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, guiding enterprise customers through the architecture, cloud infrastructure, and AI deployment patterns of their Databricks Platform on AWS. You combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to position Databricks as the foundation of your customers’ data and AI strategy.

This role can be remote. 

The Impact You Will Have

  • Guide strategic customers through the full lifecycle of Databricks on AWS, including platform administration from initial architectural design to production deployment
  • Architect and scale compute/networking infrastructure designed specifically for AI workloads, enterprise LLM deployments, and high-performance GenAI applications built on Databricks
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in core areas such as AWS infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), cloud networking, and identity management
  • Drive technical wins in competitive scenarios by demonstrating Databricks’ differentiation through custom-built solutions
  • Orchestrate cross-functional resources (DSAs, SAs, SSAs, Partners) to deliver comprehensive solutions for complex customer needs
  • Influence product direction by providing structured feedback on customer requirements and competitive gaps

What We Look For

  • 6+ years in solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role
  • Hands-on experience architecting underlying cloud infrastructure for AI/ML execution—including accelerator configuration (GPUs/TPUs), scalable model serving infrastructure, vectorized data retrieval, and balancing cloud performance vs. cost for large-scale AI workloads.
  • Advanced expertise across the following areas:
    • Security & Identity: AWS security controls, platform/network/data security, encryption, vulnerability management, compliance, and identity protocols (AWS IAM, AWS IAM Identity Center, SCIM, OAuth, SAML, Federation)
    • Networking & Deployments: AWS enterprise networking (VPC peering, AWS Direct Connect, PrivateLink), network routing, performance optimization, and large-scale deployment management
    • Platform Administration: High availability, disaster recovery, cluster orchestration, observability (Amazon CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail), and AWS Cost Management
    • Infrastructure Automation (InfraOps): Hands-on automation using IaC tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK) to build, maintain, and scale complex AWS environments
  • Strong coding proficiency in Python and SQL — you must demonstrate live coding, debugging, and solution-building skills
  • Deep expertise in distributed data systems architecture: designing scalable pipelines, streaming architectures, lakehouse patterns, and cloud-native data platforms
  • Proficient on the Databricks Platform (or demonstrated ability to achieve proficiency rapidly) with a developing technical specialization in one area (e.g., real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, migrations)
  • Proven ability to lead architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders — whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off analysis
  • Track record of driving platform adoption and consumption growth within accounts
  • Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex architectures into business value for both technical and executive audiences
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% as needed

Nice to Have

  • Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, Platform)
  • AWS certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified Data Engineer)
  • Experience with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) — understanding the landscape you'll position against
  • Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider

Interview Process

Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design and Architecture Interview → Live Coding Assessment → Presentation → Reference Check

title: Director, Delivery Solutions Architects - Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
CSQ427R326

Please note: Due to federal contract requirements and client-site access obligations, U.S. citizenship is required.

Candidates must reside in Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Virginia

As Director of Delivery Solution Architects (DSA), Public Sector, you will lead a high-impact post-sales technical organization that helps government customers realize value from the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. Your mission is to ensure that complex Data and AI initiatives—across federal civilian, defense, intelligence, state and local government, education, and public-sector-adjacent organizations—move from concept to production as quickly, securely, and effectively as possible.

You will lead DSA managers and a growing team of Delivery Solution Architects responsible for technical strategy, customer outcomes, platform adoption, and usage growth across the Public Sector. You will bridge technical strategy and durable customer value, ensuring teams guide customers through architecture decisions, implementation planning, and scalable operating models for data, analytics, AI, and agentic applications.

You will make investment and coverage decisions in collaboration with regional Sales and Field Engineering leaders, shape the value proposition of the DSA function for Public Sector, and build an organization that delivers predictable customer outcomes in a complex, high-growth environment.

The Impact You Will Have:

  • Build and lead: Recruit, coach, and scale a diverse, high-performing team of DSAs and managers. Foster a culture of psychological safety, collaboration, and customer obsession.

  • Define, operationalize, and continuously improve the post-sales execution strategy for Databricks’ Public Sector business.  

  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, Customer Success, and strategic partners to align account plans, technical success plans, resource investments, and growth strategies.  

  • Establish scalable account assignments, customer coverage, prioritization, capacity planning, and resource-allocation practices for strategic Public Sector accounts.  

  • Standardize how DSAs guide customers from use-case discovery and architecture through implementation, production go-live, adoption, and platform expansion.  

  • Lead a technically excellent DSA organization with deep expertise in cloud data platforms, data engineering, warehousing, ETL/ELT, streaming, governance, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic applications.  

  • Ensure customers receive practical, secure, scalable architectural guidance for production data products, analytics platforms, AI applications, and mission-critical workloads.  

  • Apply Public Sector-specific requirements—including security, compliance, governance, mission continuity, procurement, and complex stakeholder environments—to architecture and delivery decisions.  

  • Serve as a trusted executive technical advisor for select strategic customers, linking technical roadmaps and modernization programs to agency missions and measurable outcomes.  

  • Build strong executive and operational relationships across customer technical, program, procurement, operational, and leadership stakeholders to accelerate adoption and long-term value.  

  • Create operating mechanisms, playbooks, metrics, and review cadences to monitor customer health, delivery progress, adoption, usage growth, risks, escalations, and forecasted expansion.  

  • Drive cross-functional resolution of delivery blockers and escalations, while providing leadership feedback on field processes, product needs, programs, and organizational investments.

What We Look For:

  • 7+ years of customer-facing experience in technical delivery, architecture, consulting, customer success, professional services, or post-sales leadership roles.  
  • 5+ years of people-leadership experience, proven ability to recruit, coach, develop, and build career paths for high-performing technical talent, including success leading managers and scaling multi-level technical organizations.
  • Experience building and leading post-sales, delivery, customer success, architecture, consulting, or professional-services organizations.  
  • Deep expertise in cloud data and AI technologies, including data engineering, data warehousing, analytics, ETL/ELT, data governance, machine learning, data science, and AI.  
  • Demonstrated success delivering production-grade data products, analytics platforms, AI solutions, and other scalable, secure, and governable customer workloads.  
  • Ability to lead teams through architecture decisions, technical success planning, delivery execution, production go-lives, and customer-growth strategies.

title: Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer (Full-stack)
descriptionHtml:
Req ID: CSQ427R251
Location: Tokyo, Japan

As a Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
  • Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
  • Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
  • Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
  • Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
  • Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
  • Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
  • Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for:

  • 10+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
  • Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
  • Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
  • Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
  • Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
  • Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
  • Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
  • Documentation and white-boarding skills.
  • Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
  • Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
  • Travel to customers 20% of the time
  • Databricks Certification
  • Fluent in Japanese with a professional working proficiency in English

title: Sr. Legal Counsel, International Public Sector Compliance
descriptionHtml:
GAQ327R300

Role summaryDatabricks is seeking a Senior Counsel to scale our international Public Sector compliance program by providing practical, risk-balanced compliance and integrity advice for priority EMEA and other international markets. In this role you will partner closely with our in-region Public Sector contracting legal team and cross-functional stakeholders to enable responsible growth, and develop scalable guidance that works across jurisdictions.  You will also localize other elements of our global compliance program, advising in-region business teams and leading investigations as needed in compliance with local requirements.

The impact you will have

  • Be a trusted advisor to Public Sector stakeholders by providing timely, business-oriented compliance guidance that helps unblock deals and GTM execution across international markets.

  • Clear, executive-ready communicator who can frame risk, options and recommendations; strong cross-functional influence.

title: Credit and Collections Manager
descriptionHtml:
GAQ427R213

This Manager role within Databricks’ Credit & Collections organisation is responsible for driving credit strategy, strategic customer collections, AR performance, and complex escalations across a high-growth, usage-based Data/AI business. The role combines financial and commercial judgment with hands-on customer engagement, functional oversight of collection operations, and governance of the outsourced collections model. This is a high-impact opportunity for a CA, CPA, or experienced finance professional to take ownership of credit risk, cash, strategic customer relationships, and AR performance at Databricks scale. This is an individual contributor position with an expectation to be hands-on. 

The impact you will have:

  • Lead the Credit & Collections function for an assigned scope within Databricks, including credit policies, collection practices, risk mitigation, and escalation protocols
  • Own credit assessment, risk reviews, credit limits, payment terms, credit holds/releases, and exception management within the established approval framework
  • Make credit recommendations and decisions within delegated authority, balancing credit risk, cash conversion, and commercial considerations
  • Personally manage collections strategy and executive-level escalations for strategic and high-value Databricks customers
  • Lead resolution of complex disputes, contractual payment issues, and commercially sensitive collection matters
  • Own the monthly AR performance framework, including collection targets, cash collected vs. target, CEI, ageing, write-offs, and cash forecasting
  • Translate AR and credit trends into actionable insights for Finance leadership, including emerging risks, recovery outlook, and bad debt/reserve considerations
  • Manage the Accenture collections engagement, including SLA/KPI governance, account allocation, quality, process adherence, escalations, and corrective actions
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, RevOps, Legal, Billing, and Finance leadership to resolve high-impact credit and collection matters
  • Identify systemic drivers of delinquency and credit exposure and lead initiatives to strengthen controls, processes, and collection effectiveness
  • Drive process transformation and continuous improvement across Credit & Collections, leveraging automation, AI, analytics, and scalable operating models to improve efficiency and decision-making
  • Serve as the subject-matter authority for Credit & Collections, providing guidance on complex cases, policies, credit decisions, and commercial considerations

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting is a must; CA, CPA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • 12+ years of progressive experience across Credit & Collections, ideally within high-growth SaaS, technology, or complex B2B environments
  • Proven experience in credit risk assessment, collections strategy, and managing strategic or high-value customer relationships
  • Strong understanding of usage-based and subscription billing models, commercial contracts, and associated credit risks
  • Demonstrated experience owning AR KPIs, collection targets, CEI, DSO, ageing, cash forecasting, write-offs, and bad debt/reserve analysis
  • Experience operationalising credit policies, approval frameworks, and risk mitigation strategies
  • Experience governing outsourced collections operations against defined SLAs and performance metrics
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to translate large datasets into clear financial and risk insights
  • Advanced Excel and strong ERP/reporting systems experience; SAP, NetSuite and Salesforce preferred
  • Demonstrated experience driving process transformation, automation, or technology-enabled improvements; practical application of AI in finance or AR operations is a plus
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with customers and senior cross-functional stakeholders

title: Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable
descriptionHtml:
GAQ327R240

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — maximizing self-serve AI capabilities while driving an AI-first automation roadmap to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable, will serve as a senior individual contributor owning end-to-end technical AR accounting across global AR balances and multiple legal entities, leading multi-entity subledger consolidations as our global footprint expands. Working within a structured preparer/reviewer framework in close partnership with the broader Order-to-Cash (OTC), Revenue, and Finance Transformation teams, this high-ownership role bridges technical accounting rigor with cross-functional operational scale. 

Close quality, accurate management reporting, and subledger integrity are non-negotiable. Success in this role requires both strong operational execution and sound technical accounting judgment - applying U.S. GAAP to complex global receivables matters, bad debt modeling, and close accruals to ensure an audit-ready subledger. You will own a high-quality close today while directly shaping how our global receivables accounting operates tomorrow, using an AI-first automation mindset to scale our processes alongside rapid company growth.

The impact you will have:

  • Own the Global  AR Month-End Close: Autonomously lead the monthly close cycle for Global AR balances, preparing end-to-end subledger-to-GL reconciliations, roll-forward schedules, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue adjustments, contra-AR, complex close accruals, and AR management reporting with clear analysis of material movements and key drivers.
  • Technical Accounting & AFDA Modeling: Own the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts (AFDA) and Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) accounting models; assess underlying assumptions and portfolio trends, prepare monthly provision recommendations, process approved write-offs with full audit trails, and ensure technical U.S. GAAP compliance
  • Lead AI & Automation Adoption: Lead the identification, design, and adoption of AI and automation opportunities across AR accounting workflows, leveraging Databricks, LLMs, and advanced analytics to automate manual reconciliations, improve accrual accuracy, strengthen controls, and accelerate period closes.
  • Maintain Balance Sheet Integrity: Own AR subledger integrity, flux analyses, variance explanations, and period-over-period movement schedules, providing clear management insights into AR trends, material movements, and key balance sheet drivers for senior Finance leadership.
  • Drive Audit Readiness & SOX Controls: Maintain audit-ready workpapers and process documentation; serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors regarding AR schedules, walkthroughs, and audit request responses.
  • Cross-Functional Process Alignment: Partner with Billing Operations, Cash Applications, Revenue Assurance, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and FP&A teams to validate subledger accuracy, clear unapplied balances, and reconcile AR balances.
  • Finance Transformation & SAP Implementation: Partner with our Transformation, Engineering, and IT teams to redesign AR accounting workflows, eliminate manual routines, and drive process standardization, automation, testing, and data readiness for SAP and other systems implementations.

What we look for:

  • Experience: 6+ years of progressive AR and GL accounting experience in a mid-to-large organization, with demonstrated ownership of month-end close, AFDA/CECL, subledger-to-GL reconciliations, and AR management reporting.
  • Credentials: CPA strongly preferred. Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • Technical Accounting: Strong U.S. GAAP judgment and ability to independently research, document, and defend accounting conclusions relating to receivables, revenue recognition alignment, accrual cut-off, contract assets/liabilities, and expected credit loss methodologies.
  • Autonomy & Review Readiness: Proven ability to operate independently with high autonomy, producing clean, reviewer-ready workpapers within a preparer/reviewer/approver framework.
  • Systems & ERP: Hands-on ERP experience (SAP, NetSuite, or similar) with the ability to query, reconcile, and validate data across subledger and GL modules.
  • M&A & Integration Experience: Prior experience supporting the accounting workstream of an acquisition is a strong plus. Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving integration environments with evolving data, processes, and systems is essential.
  • The Automation Mindset: Advanced Excel proficiency (Power Query, dynamic arrays) paired with hands-on experience deploying or evaluating AI tools in a finance context; familiarity with data platforms like Databricks is a strong plus. 
  • Ownership & Mindset: High ownership, detail-oriented, fast-moving, direct communicator, and calm under pressure. Open-minded and change-oriented.
  • Scale & Agility: High-growth technology or SaaS industry experience strongly preferred; exposure to recurring or usage-based billing models is an advantage. Public accounting background preferred.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Sales Data & Agents
descriptionHtml:
P-1607

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer-obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

CRM is where revenue teams record their work, however they generally lack a solid intelligence layer. Objects are customized past recognition, history is incomplete, and reps route around whatever slows them down. As a result, the sales intelligence layer increasingly lives in a Data+AI platform. We are looking to productize with data & agents what our customers have been already manually building in our platform.

The impact you'll have:

  • Lead the modeling of sales/CRM objects, relationships, and history into a representation agents can reason over reliably
  • Lead development of agents used by reps, sales management, and revenue operations

title: Lead Learning Technical Enablement Specialist
descriptionHtml:
CSQ427R405

Role overview

We are looking for a Lead Learning Product Specialist to own the platform learning experience for Databricks customers, partners, and internal practitioners. You will sit at the intersection of product, UX, and learning science, building the systems that help data and AI teams build skills needed to become successful and confident users of the Databricks platform. 

You’ll define how users discover, practice, and demonstrate skills across in-product journeys, training, and AI-assisted guidance. You will work closely with engineering, design, curriculum, and go‑to‑market teams to translate pedagogical goals into scalable platform capabilities, from adaptive learning flows and assessments to analytics that prove real skill development.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI‑first learning systems on the Databricks platform, anchored on contextual,  in the flow of work enablement and a unified skills infrastructure.
  • Design experiences that surface targeted knowledge precisely when users need it, triggered by real work context (e.g., usage patterns, errors, task types), reducing interruptions and friction.
  • Translate learning and pedagogical goals into platform capabilities such as learner models, skills graphs, progress tracking, adaptive learning paths, assessments, and feedback loops.
  • Partner with UX and content design to create intuitive, embedded guidance and learning patterns that feel like part of the workflow, not separate training destinations.
  • Collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to ensure learning and skills systems are reliable, secure, performant, and able to serve global enterprise customers at scale.
  • Define and evolve predictive signals and analytics that give proactive visibility into emerging skills and capability gaps, enabling action before they impact business outcomes.
  • Build features and tooling that allow enablement teams to deliver at-scale personalization - leveraging AI and automation.
  • Provide employees and leaders with transparent views into skills, enablement activities, and progress toward role and organizational goals through dashboards, reports, and in‑product insights.
  • Work closely with education, documentation, and curriculum teams to empower them with self‑service configuration and experimentation tools for new learning experiences.
  • Engage directly with customers, partners, and internal field teams to deeply understand learning needs across roles and transform these into clear product requirements.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

  • A cohesive, AI‑first skills platform and experience is live, guiding users from first login with contextual, just‑in‑time experiences triggered by work context.
  • Clear, trusted metrics exist for learning efficacy and skill attainment and used to drive roadmap decisions. 
  • Predictive insights into emerging capability and skills gaps are available to leaders, enabling proactive interventions before they impact business performance.
  • Enablement teams use platform tools you defined to deliver personalized learning and guidance at scale without needing to grow headcount proportionally.
  • Learning and skills capabilities are integrated with broader Databricks platform features and measurably improve adoption and expansion.

Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in product management, UX-focused product roles, or learning/education platforms, ideally within B2B SaaS, developer tools, or data/AI products.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a product area end to end: defining strategy and roadmap, writing PRDs, collaborating with engineering and design, and shipping impactful user-facing features.
  • Experience building or working on learning systems, training platforms, or content/knowledge experiences (LMS, certification, education analytics, in-product guidance, or similar).
  • Strong UX instincts and a track record of collaborating closely with designers and researchers to create intuitive flows, information architectures, and content experiences.
  • Comfort working with data: defining metrics, instrumenting experiments, and using analytics to understand user behavior, learning outcomes, and skills gaps.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex concepts simply and advocate for learners across the organization.
  • Experience with AI-powered learning, adaptive systems, or building products that incorporate LLMs into user workflows

descriptionHtml:
Location: Tokyo, Japan

Mission

As a Pre-sales Solutions Architect focused on Manufacturing and Automotive, you will engage with leading global automotive manufacturers and strategic industry accounts across Japan. In partnership with Account Executives, Solutions Architects, technology specialists, partners, and customer teams, you will develop and execute technical strategies that help customers adopt the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform and achieve measurable business outcomes.

You will translate complex automotive and manufacturing challenges into scalable data and AI solutions across vehicle platforms, connected-vehicle analytics, vehicle and component quality, supply-chain optimization, smart manufacturing, engineering and R&D analytics, aftersales, customer intelligence, and AI-powered applications.   • Lead workshops, seminars, meetups, and other community activities to build technical awareness and scale best practices in Japan.

What we look for

  • Experience engaging with complex customers and sales lifecycles in a technical pre-sales, consulting, technical architecture, or equivalent role.
  • A technical background in data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or related fields.
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on public cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Hands-on expertise delivering complex proof-of-concepts and technical demonstrations.
  • Ability to code in Python or SQL and willingness to learn or deepen knowledge of Apache Spark™; experience with Scala, Java, or R is beneficial.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data platforms, distributed data systems, analytics, machine learning, generative AI, or modern cloud architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical solutions for specialized customer needs and navigate a competitive landscape.
  • Ability to influence decision-makers and C-level executives by building relationships and orchestrating cross-functional teams toward long-term customer success.
  • Builder mindset with a track record of prototyping, creating demos, and crafting tailored solutions for ambiguous or challenging customer environments.
  • Strong communication, presentation, whiteboarding, and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers and building trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to partner effectively with Account Executives, Solutions Architects, specialists, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Business-professional fluency in Japanese; business-level English proficiency is preferred.

Preferred experience

  • Experience working with leading automotive manufacturers, automotive suppliers, industrial companies, transportation providers, or mobility businesses.

title: Customer Enablement Architect (Capability Engineering & AI Adoption)
descriptionHtml:
CSQ427R440

The Databricks Customer Enablement team is on a mission to upskill data and AI professionals in customer organizations so they can use Databricks effectively and accelerate customer success.

As a Customer Enablement Architect, you will design and lead customer enablement and talent-transformation programs across Australia and New Zealand. You will partner with Sales, Field Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Training Delivery, and Operations to understand customer needs, recommend the right learning solutions, and ensure successful execution. 

You will balance strategic customer engagement with program and commercial execution across training bookings, revenue, learners, credentials, and adoption. You will bring enough technical depth to understand Databricks curriculum and certifications, make credible recommendations, and engage confidently with technical stakeholders—without being expected to deliver deep hands-on technical training. 

The impact you will have

  • Work with regional Go-to-Market teams to create enablement strategies aligned to customer segment, business priorities, technical maturity, and talent-transformation goals.
  • Translate customer outcomes into practical learning plans, capability roadmaps, and recommendations across free and paid training, instructor-led and self-paced learning, credentials, and partner delivery.
  • Partner with global Delivery and Operations teams to coordinate scheduling, communications, program quality, and seamless execution of customer development plans.
  • Manage and report weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance across training bookings, revenue, learners, credentials, and adoption; use insights to guide action from field teams.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer for regional enablement, curriculum, and certification priorities, while engaging senior leaders and executives internally and externally.
  • Identify capability gaps that may affect platform adoption and work with account teams on targeted interventions, including contextual or just-in-time enablement where it improves customer outcomes.

Technical context you will support

You will help customers build capability across areas such as:

  • Lakehouse architecture, data engineering, ETL, data governance, and data quality
  • Databricks training, certifications, and foundational onboarding experiences
  • Generative AI, agentic workflows, Databricks Apps, Genie, and Lakeflow
  • Translating technical adoption needs into accessible enablement and talent-transformation programs

title: Staff Software Engineer, Lakeflow Pipelines DR
descriptionHtml:
RDQ427R70

Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the data lifecycle with a unified Lakehouse platform for data engineering, analytics, and AI. The Lakehouse addresses major challenges in enterprise data platforms, including reliability, data staleness, operational complexity, total cost of ownership, and data lock-in. Learn more about the Lakehouse architecture.

Lakeflow is a critical part of this vision, helping customers build and operate streaming and batch ETL  pipelines that power business-critical data products. As these workloads become increasingly mission-critical, customers need them to continue operating through infrastructure failures and cloud-region outages.

As a Staff Engineer on the part of the Lakeflow Disaster Recovery team, you will design and implement distributed systems that replicate and recover pipelines across regions. A pipeline is more than source code and output tables: it includes streaming checkpoints, source offsets, stateful operator state, table versions, transaction metadata, schedules, and dependencies across a dataflow graph. You will solve challenging problems involving consistency, idempotency, causal ordering, failover, failback, and safe recovery without silent data loss or duplication.

You will work in one or more of the following areas:

  • Cross-region replication and recovery for Lakeflow pipelines, streaming tables, and materialized views
  • Distributed consistency across pipeline dependencies, table versions, and transaction logs
  • Failover and failback workflows with conservative correctness guardrails
  • Deep clone, metadata reconciliation, observability, and failure-injection testing
  • High-fidelity recovery simulations, game-day testing, and formal reasoning about failure modes

What we look for:

  • A passion for distributed systems, databases, storage systems, streaming systems, or reliability engineering
  • Strong software engineering skills in Java, Scala, C++, Go, Python, or a similar production language
  • Understanding of consistency, transactions, idempotency, replication, checkpointing, and data lineage
  • Ability to define and work toward a multi-year technical vision with incremental, production-quality deliverables
  • 8+ years of experience working on related systems preferred
  • Optional: PhD or advanced research experience in databases, distributed systems, or storage

This role offers the opportunity to build the foundations of resilient Lakehouse computing and help customers keep their data pipelines running when failure matters most.

descriptionHtml:
P-298

About Databricks

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

The Role

As enterprise data enclaves and Generative AI applications become mission-critical to national security and public sector modernization, maintaining the reliability and operational integrity of the underlying platform is paramount. Sitting at the vital intersection of core infrastructure operations and active platform reliability, this team serves as the ultimate technical authority for our platform across GovCloud, FedRAMP High, and air-gapped environments.

In this role, you will move beyond basic ticket resolution to handle the hardest technical escalations across our platform domains—including Compute, Networking, Storage, IAM, and OS internals. You will partner directly with Core Engineering, conduct deep live troubleshooting, safely execute automation tools, and isolate complex system boundary blocks inside secure enclaves. If you are a systems specialist who thrives under pressure, enjoys writing custom tooling to unblock platform bottlenecks, and wants to safeguard the infrastructure powering next-generation federal AI workloads, this opportunity provides unmatched scope and impact.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:

The Opportunity

Multi-cloud is core to Databricks product strategy. Compute serves as the layer that abstracts the cloud from the rest of the company. Building unified infrastructure on top of heterogeneous clouds is a challenge that few companies experience.

As an engineer on this team, you won’t just manage infrastructure; you will build it as a product. You will tackle the hard problems of distributed systems: sub-second container/MicroVM startup times, multi-tenant security isolation, and building a unified orchestration layer that scales across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build the next generation of our Serverless platform, focusing on high availability, low latency, and scale-to-zero efficiency.
  • Build a single compute stack that supports heterogeneous workloads, including GPU instance qualification for AI training and stateful execution for Lakebase.
  • Solve Multi-Cloud Complexity: Develop platform-level abstractions that allow Databricks to run seamlessly across all major cloud providers.
  • Optimize everything from the API gateway down to the host-level networking and container orchestration.
  • Work alongside industry experts who have built world-class systems like Borg, Kubernetes, and Uber’s infrastructure.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of production-level experience in one of: Python, Java, Scala, C++, or a similar language
  • 4+ years of experience developing large-scale distributed systems from scratch
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or MicroVM technologies (e.g., Firecracker) and a strong grasp of cloud provider internals (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • You aren't just a user of tools; you understand how to build them from the ground up when existing solutions fail at our scale.

title: Sr. Partner Solutions Architect - Customer Lake & Lakewatch
descriptionHtml:
FEQ327R438

As a Sr. Partner Solutions Architect specializing in Customer Lake and Lakewatch, you are an expert-level technical leader responsible for accelerating platform adoption and scaling growth across our strategic partner ecosystem (SIs, GSIs, ISVs, and Cloud Providers). You serve as the definitive technical authority and trusted advisor for partner technical practices, empowering them to architect, position, and deploy enterprise solutions built on our Customer Lake platform, while leveraging Lakewatch for data quality and system monitoring. Operating at the intersection of deep technical leadership, partner enablement, and strategic executive influence, you serve as a force multiplier across your region and partner channel.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Scale Partner Practice Growth: Train and enable partner technical teams (SIs, GSIs, ISVs) to build repeatable, high-value practices around Customer Lake and Lakewatch
  • Drive Partner-Led Platform Consumption: Co-architect complex partner solutions that accelerate customer adoption, deployment velocity, and platform usage across Customer Lake environments
  • Expand Lakewatch Observability: Guide partner engineering teams on deploying Lakewatch to deliver automated data quality monitoring and health telemetry across customer implementations
  • Advise Partner Leadership: Act as a trusted technical advisor to partner CTOs, Chief Architects, and Practice Leads, aligning their technology roadmaps with Customer Lake and Lakewatch innovations
  • Build Reusable Blueprints: Develop enablement kits, reference architectures, and deployment blueprints that simplify partner integration and rollout
  • Orchestrate Cross-Functional Teams: Collaborate across internal Field Engineering, Product, and Partner Management teams to deliver unified partner GTM initiatives

What We Look For

  • 8+ years in solutions architecture, partner technical management, principal engineering, or senior customer-/partner-facing technical pre-sales roles
  • Proven track record working with system integrators (SIs/GSIs), cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), or strategic technology partners (ISVs)
  • Expert-level coding proficiency — Python, SQL, and ideally Spark/PySpark. You will complete a live coding assessment and a platform build during the interview
  • Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture: distributed systems, real-time/streaming, Customer Lake design patterns, data governance frameworks, and cloud-native platforms
  • Deep knowledge of data observability, automated data quality, and platform telemetry using Lakewatch or equivalent monitoring tools
  • Expert-level Databricks Platform knowledge (or equivalent depth in competing platforms with demonstrated rapid learning ability)
  • Declared technical specialization with recognized depth — e.g., real-time architectures, ML/AI platforms, data governance, large-scale migrations, or industry-specific solutions
  • Proven track record of driving consumption growth and platform adoption in large accounts
  • Executive presence — ability to influence VPs, Practice Directors, and C-level stakeholders on long-term data and AI strategy
  • Experience leading competitive displacements and complex enterprise evaluations
  • Strong strategic thinking — connecting technical architecture decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience); advanced degrees are valued

Nice to Have

  • Databricks certifications
  • Prior experience at Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Google, Microsoft, or a top-tier data/AI company
  • Published thought leadership (blogs, conference talks, open source contributions)
  • Industry vertical expertise with executive-level domain credibility

Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design and Architecture Interview → Live Coding Assessment → Presentation → Reference Check

descriptionHtml:

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data and AI problems by utilizing the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, and Field Engineering to accelerate adoption and growth of the Databricks platform. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers design, implement, scale, and optimize data and AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.

This is a technical and customer-facing role focused on architecture, technical strategy, and customer outcomes. You will influence technical execution across complex use cases, guide architectural decisions, and align Databricks, customer, and partner teams from technical win through production and adoption.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Define and influence technical execution strategies across complex use cases and multiple workstreams within strategic accounts
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer technical leads and architects, leading architecture discussions and guiding technical decisions
  • Design secure, governed, and scalable Databricks architectures while balancing performance, cost, reliability, and long-term needs
  • Build and demonstrate working solutions, prototypes, and reusable technical assets that accelerate customer outcomes
  • Anticipate platform maturity and scaling needs and establish best practices for security, governance, and operational excellence
  • Drive adoption and consumption by influencing architecture, unblocking delivery, and connecting technical execution to business outcomes
  • Partner across Databricks, customer, and implementation teams to align resources, manage risks, and accelerate delivery
  • Mentor peers and contribute reusable technical guidance, frameworks, and enablement across the organization

What We Look For

  • Experience in influencing technical strategy and architecture across complex customer use cases or multiple workstreams
  • Strong coding proficiency in Python, SQL, or similar languages, with the ability to build, debug, and validate technical solutions
  • Deep understanding of distributed data systems, data engineering, analytics, data warehousing, AI/ML, and modern cloud architectures
  • Experience designing secure, governed, scalable, and production-ready data solutions

title: Sr. Designated Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
P-1448

Important Notes:

  • This is a hybrid role and requires ~3 days in the office in São Paulo-SP. Our office is in Av Faria Lima.
  • Please, submit your application and resume in English.

About the Role

As a Designated Support Engineer (DSE) at Databricks, you will serve as the principal technical support advisor and voice of the customer for our most strategic enterprise accounts leveraging technical experience and business skills.

In this role, you will lead high-touch, support-driven customer engagements, and provide proactive advisory. You will leverage support trends, ticket history, and operational telemetry to ensure the operational health, scale, and resiliency of customer data platforms. This self-motivated professional will demonstrate high commitment to both customers and internal teams, with excellent communication, project management, and problem-solving skills.

While this is a support-anchored role, you will play a critical role in driving proactive operational best practices, mitigating risk, and bridging customer challenges directly with Databricks Product, Engineering, and Field teams.

Responsibilities & Core Duties

  • Technical & Architectural Guidance: Guide external stakeholders on operational best practices and architectural design across Distributed Data Processing (Apache Spark™), Query Optimization, Lakehouse open table formats (Delta Lake, Iceberg), Cloud Infrastructure & IaC, OS, Networking and Containerization (Kubernetes/Docker), Security & Governance, and Data Warehousing.
  • Proactive Operational Health & Trend Analysis: Leverage support history, ticket metrics, and system telemetry to deliver predictive health checks, risk assessments, and preventive recommendations - applying deep platform domain knowledge to advise customers on environment scaling, upgrade readiness, and long-term platform stability.
  • Critical Escalation & Technical Incident Facilitation: Coordinate and facilitate critical, high-impact escalations by aligning customer leadership with internal Databricks Escalation Engineers and Core Engineering teams to ensure swift, well-communicated resolutions.
  • Strategic Support Ownership: Serve as the strategic ambassador for the Databricks Support organization, operating as the customer’s dedicated operational quarterback to align platform operations with business goals and ensure enterprise accounts realize maximum business value.
  • Executive Reporting & Operational Governance: Lead regular Support Business Reviews (SBRs/QBRs) for customer leadership, articulating ticket health trends, Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), upgrade readiness roadmaps, and strategic operational trade-offs.
  • Voice of the Customer Advocacy: Synthesize customer operational patterns, systemic technical friction, and platform blockers, channeling actionable feedback directly into Databricks Product, Support, and Engineering organizations to steer platform reliability and enhance customer experience.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as Premier Support Engineer (DSE), Technical Account Manager (TAM), Solutions Architect, or Senior Escalation Engineer in distributed data or cloud environments.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience designing, developing, testing, and sustaining Python, Java, or Scala-based applications.
  • Demonstrated technical depth in three (3) or more of the following core domains:
    • Distributed Data & Lakehouse Architectures: Apache Spark™, Delta Lake, structured streaming, and query execution/tuning.
    • Cloud Infrastructure & Automation: AWS, Azure, or GCP compute/storage/networking and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
    • OS, Networking & Containerization: Linux administration, core networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S), and container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes).
    • Security & Data Governance: Enterprise IAM, SSO/OAuth, network security, and data governance frameworks (e.g., Databricks Unity Catalog).
    • Data Warehousing & Analytics: OLAP query plan optimization, indexing, and data platform performance tuning.
  • Support Telemetry & Trend Analysis: Proven ability to leverage case data, ticket telemetry, and root-cause analyses (RCAs) to identify patterns, mitigate operational risks, and drive case/escalation reduction goals.
  • Customer Leadership Influence: Track record of advising and influencing customer technical leaders (Managers, Directors, Lead Architects) on operationalizing, scaling, and optimizing platform environments.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, STEM field, or equivalent practical experience.
