title: Sr Staff Technical Program Manager- Security
descriptionHtml:
P-1489

About Databricks

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems;  from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers and customer obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

The Role 

We are seeking a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to own and lead a company-wide portfolio of security programs spanning Trust & Safety Engineering, Identity and Access Management, Platform Security, Security Operations, Product Security, and IT.

This role will take a major security risk portfolio from strategy to measurable risk reduction by driving prioritization, architecture alignment, investment planning, execution, adoption, and operationalization. The scope connects customer-facing product security with internal engineering and enterprise controls across Databricks’ product, corporate, and Databricks-on-Databricks environments.

Success means advancing a complex security domain, creating clarity where direction is incomplete, and materially improving Databricks’ security posture, customer trust, and ability to operate at scale. The TPM will structure ambiguous problems, evaluate technical and resourcing tradeoffs, establish durable decision mechanisms, and align VP- and Director-level organizations with competing priorities and shared dependencies.

This is an executive-facing role and a trusted partner to C-suite executives, VPs of Engineering and Product, Security executives, and senior architects. The TPM will communicate risk, options, decisions, progress, and escalations with precision; embed security commitments in technical roadmaps and launch processes; and strengthen secure-by-default controls, measurable risk ownership, and operational readiness. The role will also elevate the broader TPM community through mentorship, reusable operating mechanisms, and high standards for technical program leadership.

This position is located on-site in Bellevue, WA; Seattle, WA; San Francisco, CA; or Mountain View, CA.

The Impact You’ll Have

  • Architect and drive execution of strategic security initiatives across Trust & Safety Engineering, Identity and Access Management, Security, and IT.
  • Establish company-wide processes to identify, track, and resolve high-risk security issues while influencing architecture and infrastructure decisions.
  • Connect core security infrastructure to platform services so unified identity, data lineage, and audit controls extend across structured, unstructured, and AI workloads.
  • Resolve cross-organizational blockers with Director-, VP-, and C-suite engineering leaders while balancing technical tradeoffs and resource constraints.
  • Mentor TPMs and strengthen standards for technical rigor, operational execution, and program management.
  • Represent Databricks’ security architecture and posture in executive technical reviews and, where appropriate, industry forums.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum Qualifications
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical experience.
    • 10+ years of progressive experience in technical program management, engineering program management, security program management, or an equivalent technical leadership role.
    • Demonstrated ability to translate security, privacy, policy, and compliance objectives into technical strategy, architecture decisions, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
    • Demonstrated ability to resolve conflicting priorities and resource constraints across cross-functional teams without direct authority, establish organization-wide engineering processes, and deliver complex, multi-team roadmaps.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical strategies to executive engineering leaders.
    • Experience using AI-enabled tools to accelerate program strategy, technical problem-solving, analysis, and automation.
    • Ability to work onsite three days per week in Bellevue, Seattle, San Francisco, or Mountain View.
  • Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience operating in hyperscale cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, or in complex distributed data-processing environments.
    • Prior hands-on experience as a software, systems, or security engineer before transitioning to Technical Program Management.
    • Familiarity with unified data governance architectures, distributed-systems security, and or security controls supporting AI and machine-learning infrastructure.
    • Experience with external security research, open-source contributions, or speaking at major technical conferences.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Sr. Solutions Architect (L6)

The Role

As a Sr. Solutions Architect, you are an expert-level technical leader responsible for the organization's most complex customer engagements. You drive consumption strategy, own executive-level relationships, and serve as the definitive technical authority for your accounts. You have declared your archetype—a recognized technical specialization that makes you a force multiplier across your team and region. You operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise, strategic account planning, and executive influence. 

The Impact You Will Have

  • Drive the technical and consumption strategy for the organization's most complex customer engagements, directly influencing platform adoption and revenue growth.
  • Own senior-level technical relationships — serving as a trusted advisor on enterprise data and AI strategy
  • Lead the most complex architecture engagements: multi-workload platforms, enterprise-wide migrations, real-time systems, and AI/ML at scale
  • Operate as an Expert on the Databricks Platform with a declared archetype — actively mentoring others and driving horizontal impact across your team
  • Develop and execute competitive strategies for your customers, positioning Databricks against incumbent and emerging platforms
  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams (DSAs, SSAs, Partners, Product) to deliver enterprise-grade solutions

  • 8+ years in solutions architecture, principal engineering, technical pre-sales leadership, or a senior customer-facing technical role
  • Expert-level coding proficiency — Python, SQL, and ideally Spark/PySpark. You will complete a live coding assessment and a platform build during the interview
  • Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture: distributed systems at scale, streaming/real-time, lakehouse design patterns, data governance frameworks, and cloud-native platforms

Global Genie Sales Leader

We are looking for a highly strategic and execution-oriented Genie Global Leader to lead a team of specialists responsible for growing the Databricks Genie business globally.

Databricks Genie extends the Data Intelligence Platform into conversational AI through Genie One, delivering a true AI co-worker for non-technical business teams and leaders. This role sits at the center of a major shift in enterprise architecture as organizations move away from fragmented stacks consisting of legacy BI tools, static dashboards, and separate AI interfaces toward a unified, conversational data platform powered by enterprise context.

You will lead a team of specialists partnering with Account Executives, Solution Architects, and Sales Leadership to help customers modernize their business intelligence, democratize data access across non-technical users, and operationalize conversational AI in production analytics workflows. This role requires both strong sales leadership and the ability to establish and scale a new sales motion across a global field organization.

You will build and lead a team of Delivery Solution Architects (DSAs) responsible for the post-sales success of Databricks' largest Financial Services customers. About Databricks

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers, and customer obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with federal customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap

What we look for:

  • 6+ years experience in software engineering, AI/ML, or data platforms & analytics
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Applied Science, Mathematics,  Engineering, or equivalent relevant years of experience in an Engineering function
  • Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks

title: Sr. Automation Engineer - IT Asset Management
descriptionHtml:
Sr. Automation Engineer - IT Asset Management

Req ID: GAQ427R222

About the Role

As a Senior Automation Engineer on the IT Asset Management team at Databricks, you will be the technical engine behind transforming how we manage ~$XXM/yr in asset spend across SaaS licenses and hardware. Your primary mission is to eliminate manual toil and build scalable, AI-powered automation that makes asset operations fast, accurate, and effortless as Databricks scales past 14,000 employees.

Your initial focus will be on IT asset management workflows: automating new hire laptop provisioning, SaaS license lifecycle management, asset data reconciliation, and hardware recovery. Over time, you will expand your automation footprint across IT Support and Operations, including IT support workflows, AV/VC and event support, and incident response management.

This role requires a strong automation-first mindset, the ability to learn new domains quickly, and comfort building with AI/LLM tools. You will report to the Senior Manager of IT Asset Management.

The Impact You Will Have

  • New hire laptop provisioning: Build end-to-end automation for assigning, configuring, and shipping laptops to new hires, targeting a 75% reduction in manual ticket toil.
  • SaaS license lifecycle: Automate license consumption monitoring, inactivity-based seat clawbacks, renewal alerting, and cost optimization workflows to help drive $1.5M+ in annual savings and cost avoidance.
  • Asset data quality: Automate CMDB/inventory reconciliation, deduplication, and multi-device detection to bring asset records to audit-ready accuracy.
  • Offboarding asset recovery: Automate tracking and recovery of hardware from exiting employees, reducing loss and improving chain-of-custody compliance.
  • Broader IT Ops automation (over time): Extend automation into IT support, AV/VC and event support, and incident response management as the ITAM automation foundation matures.

What We Are Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, automation engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-system automation projects with measurable business impact.
  • Strong automation-first mindset: you see a manual process and immediately think about how to build a scalable, reliable automated solution.
  • Ability to operate with minimal guidance, take ownership of ambiguous problems, and deliver consistently high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
  • We value a great generalist who can learn a domain quickly over a narrow specialist. You should be comfortable ramping into unfamiliar systems and business processes and building effective automation without needing deep prior domain expertise.

AI and LLM Automation

  • Hands-on experience building workflows, agents, or tools powered by large language models (e.g., Claude, GPT, Gemini, or similar).
  • Ability to design AI-powered automation that handles unstructured inputs, makes decisions, and integrates with enterprise systems.
  • Experience with prompt engineering, agent frameworks, or AI-assisted code generation in a production or operational context.
  • Comfort evaluating and selecting the right AI approach for a given problem, whether that is a deterministic rule, an LLM call, or a hybrid.

Automation and Integration

  • Experience building and troubleshooting integrations between IT platforms such as ITSM tools (FreshService, ServiceNow, or similar), identity platforms, and asset management systems.
  • Experience designing automation for IT operational processes: onboarding/offboarding, access provisioning, license management, asset tracking, or similar.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, scripting (Python, Bash, or similar), and the ability to connect systems that were not designed to talk to each other.
  • Experience with data pipelines, ETL, or data quality workflows is a plus.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. Comfortable working with IT operations, security, procurement, finance, and vendor partners.
  • Effective at documenting solutions and training peers on new tools and processes.
  • Clear communicator who can translate complex technical work into business terms for non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Databricks, data lakehouse architectures, or SQL-based analytics platforms.
  • Experience with IT asset management or SaaS management tools (e.g., Oomnitza, Productiv, Zluri, or similar).
  • Experience with no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Tines, Workato, or similar).
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes or IT service management frameworks.

Location

US-based, West Coast preferred.

The Incident Response team's mission is to respond to security threats, incidents and investigations to protect our customers, employees and enterprise data in a fast, efficient and standardised manner. title: Sr. Security Engineer, Enterprise Security
descriptionHtml:
RDQ427R608

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other US locations will be considered.

---

About the Team

The Enterprise Security team at Databricks is responsible for securing the corporate environment, including the SaaS platforms, internal tools, integrations, automation workflows, and AI-adjacent systems that Databricks employees and operations depend on.

We work at the intersection of enterprise architecture, security engineering, and business enablement, partnering with IT, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and Procurement to surface risk early, set enforceable security standards, and enable the business to operate securely at scale.

The Role

As a Sr. Security Engineer on the Enterprise Security team, you turn security requirements into working protections across Databricks' enterprise environment.

You implement, integrate, test, and improve security controls across enterprise applications, identity, endpoint, network, SaaS, and data-security systems. You bring strong hands-on engineering experience, developing automation and reusable capabilities that strengthen preventive controls, improve security coverage, and reduce repetitive manual work.

You work closely with security domain leads, IT, and platform owners to translate approved security designs into practical implementations. Your focus is on delivering reliable controls, automating recurring security checks and workflows, and continuously validating that protections remain effective as enterprise systems evolve.

The Impact You Will Have

Security Control Engineering & Implementation

  • Implement and improve preventive security controls across enterprise systems, translating approved security requirements into tested, operational protections.

  • Partner with security domain leads, IT, and platform owners to implement access, configuration, endpoint, network, and data-protection guardrails.

  • Develop reusable technical implementations and secure configuration patterns that improve consistency and reduce recurring security gaps.

Security Automation & Integrations

  • Build and maintain security automation using Python, Go, APIs, Terraform, or comparable technologies to improve control enforcement and operational efficiency.

  • Automate recurring configuration checks, access validation, evidence collection, and remediation workflows to reduce dependency on manual security processes.

  • Develop and integrate AI-assisted and agent-based security automation to streamline recurring reviews, control validation, and remediation workflows, with appropriate access controls, testing, and auditability.

  • Integrate security platforms and enterprise systems to streamline established review and approval workflows, surface actionable findings, and support consistent enforcement.

Continuous Control Validation & Remediation

  • Develop automated testing, monitoring, and validation capabilities to confirm security controls operate as intended.

  • Identify control gaps, configuration drift, and ineffective enforcement; partner with system owners to implement and validate remediation.

  • Measure improvements in security coverage, control effectiveness, automation reliability, and reduced manual effort.

Cross-Functional Security Engineering

  • Partner with Enterprise Security, IT, Engineering, and business-system owners to deliver security improvements across interconnected enterprise platforms.

  • Troubleshoot complex implementation challenges involving authentication, API integrations, permissions, configurations, and security tooling.

  • Contribute to Security by Design initiatives by translating recurring security requirements into reusable controls, automated checks, and secure defaults.

What We Look For

  • 7+ years of experience in security engineering, enterprise security, infrastructure security, cloud security, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience implementing, integrating, testing, and maintaining security controls in production enterprise environments.

  • Strong programming and automation skills using Python, Go, or comparable languages, including API integrations, infrastructure-as-code, and version control.

  • Experience engineering security controls across one or more domains, such as identity, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, network, or data protection.

  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, SSO, OAuth, service identities, API security, secrets management, and least-privilege principles.

  • Experience developing automated security checks, configuration validation, drift detection, and remediation workflows.

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI-assisted or agent-based security automation, including appropriate access controls, testing, monitoring, and auditability.

  • Ability to translate approved security requirements into preventive controls, troubleshoot implementation challenges, and validate control effectiveness.

  • Experience applying reliable software engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, error handling, and operational monitoring.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently deliver security engineering improvements, collaborate with Security, IT, and platform owners, and achieve measurable security outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience implementing security controls across multiple enterprise security domains rather than specializing in a single area.

  • Familiarity with enterprise security platforms and technologies such as Okta, Google Workspace, CrowdStrike, Jamf, Prisma Access, or similar solutions.

  • Experience with specialized policy-as-code frameworks such as Open Policy Agent (OPA), Rego, or comparable enforcement technologies.

  • Experience securing enterprise data and AI platforms, including Databricks or comparable technologies.

  • Experience working in large-scale or rapidly growing cloud and SaaS environments.

Databricks Executive Assistants are strategic partners who drive efficiency, foster collaboration, and enable our most senior leaders to scale their impact. We are seeking an Executive Assistant in Amsterdam to support R&D Leaders within our R&D organization. This is a multi-executive role: the EA will serve as the primary partner to  Engineering R&D Leaders based in Amsterdam, while also supporting at least one additional R&D leader in EMEA. The role requires balancing distinct executive styles, priorities, and cadences, not simply duplicating the same support model across leaders. The ideal candidate is autonomous, direct, and confident in their judgment and thrives in a fast-paced R&D environment where executives value independence over hand-holding.

Impact you will have:

  • Executive Assistants are empowered to focus on strategic priorities, resulting in a more effective and agile organization.
  • Proactively manage and optimize complex, multi-time zone calendars for R&D Vice Presidents and leaders, ensuring alignment with business priorities and anticipating potential conflicts.
  • Coordinate scheduling across multiple teams and organizations, ensuring seamless collaboration for leaders who operate cross-functionally.
  • Support engineering planning cycles, quarterly business reviews, and cross-team syncs during key milestones.
  • Own end-to-end expense and travel processes, ensuring compliance while identifying patterns and opportunities to streamline recurring workflows.
  • Proactively identify and communicate preparation requirements for meetings, ensuring leaders arrive well-prepared and informed.
  • Partner with Belgrade site operations to support office events and team activities through collaborative work with strong local partners.
  • Build and maintain accurate records of meetings, events, and requests, ensuring timely follow-up and closure.
  • Prepare and review briefing materials, agendas, and follow-up documentation for executive meetings, including engineering leadership forums, R&D reviews, and cross-functional planning sessions.
  • Own the operational rhythm for your executives — driving action item tracking, follow-up loops, and meeting cadence management so nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Provide coverage and support for other assistants as needed, demonstrating flexibility and a team-first mindset.
  • Handle highly confidential information with the utmost discretion and integrity.
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration by building strong relationships with other EAs and R&D stakeholders across the organization.
  • Provide on-the-ground support and coordination for visiting leadership and ensure seamless execution of visits.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, HR, Marketing, Education, or a related area is preferred.

The Impact You Will Have

The pace of Data and AI is outrunning how most teams enable their field. Our Field has distinct roles, tenures, segments, industries, and regions. The problem? Generic enablement doesn’t meet their needs. 

In this role, you will help Databricks revolutionize the way we enable by building the strategy, plan, process, and engine that turns globally applicable enablement into targeted tracks for every seller. At Databricks, we are all builders. Partnering with the Global Sales Enablement team and Enablement Partners in-region, you will ship the apps, AI skills, and processes that make this a reality for our Field.

This is an individual-contributor role; you lead through cross-functional influence and what you build.

What You'll Do

  • Own the strategy, plan, process, and engine that enables GTM motions and skills-based enablement across sales and sales development roles.
  • Build the AI-native system that adapts globally applicable enablement into personalized tracks by role, tenure and skill, segment, and industry.
  • Build hands-on: apps, agents and skills, content, and automated processes, all AI-first, piloting and iterating fast rather than waiting for perfection.

  • Within 6 to 12 months, a functional, AI-first process that delivers personalized enablement by role, tenure, segment, and industry.
  • Your work moves the numbers that matter: faster ramp, higher seller productivity, and measurable influence on downstream pipeline and win rates.
  • Globally applicable enablement flows into personalized tracks through a repeatable process.
  • Regional teams treat the model as their own, and the operating rigor you install becomes the standard beyond your own programs.
  • Databricks never launches another “one-size-fits-all” initiative again.

title: Data+AI Workforce Transformation Practitioner — Customer Delivery
descriptionHtml:
CSQ327R12

Enterprise customers are investing in AI, but most are stuck between a successful pilot and real organizational adoption. The gap is not technology. It is whether the workforce can change how it works.

You will own end-to-end workforce transformation engagements with Databricks' largest customers. You will diagnose where a customer's workforce is today, define what needs to change, build the transformation plan, and drive execution until adoption sticks. You are the directly responsible individual for each engagement, not a contributor to someone else's project.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Own the full transformation lifecycle for each customer, from workforce assessment through capability pathways, operating rhythm, and measurement. You build the plan and you execute it.
  • Run 2 to 3 concurrent engagements across different formats. These range from short-cycle assessments (2 to 4 weeks) to coached transformations (8 to 12 weeks) to deep embedded engagements (12 to 16 weeks). You will manage a mixed portfolio simultaneously.
  • Design for multiple organizational layers within a single engagement. That means building executive sponsorship with CDOs, CIOs, and CHROs while also architecting the manager enablement and individual contributor adoption layers underneath.
  • Drive execution, not just planning. You will stand up the operating rhythm, coach internal champions, unblock adoption barriers, and adjust the plan when reality diverges from the model.
  • Design the human-agent collaboration model for each customer's workforce. Assess workflows and distinguish what should stay human from what should be automated, agent-assisted, or fully agent-led. Design differentiated pathways for builders in technical roles and users in workflow roles.
  • Shape how engagements are scoped and priced. You are closest to the work and will ensure that commercial commitments are deliverable.
  • Turn what you learn into repeatable tools and playbooks that can scale beyond practitioner-led delivery.
  • Partner with technical deployment, AI transformation, and account teams. Other teams build and land the solution. You own what happens after.

What We Look For

  • 8 or more years leading workforce or organizational transformation in a technology adoption context. You have executed transformations and owned outcomes, not just designed programs.
  • You have led conversations with C-suite or VP-level sponsors and influenced how organizations adopt technology at scale.
  • You have done the work, not just designed a curriculum about it. The strongest backgrounds include customer-side data or engineering leaders who drove transformation, former solutions architects or engineers who moved into transformation roles, and consultants with hands-on delivery experience.
  • You can assess a workflow, identify what needs to change, and design the capability pathway to get there.
  • You understand change management, including sponsorship models, adoption curves, resistance patterns, and how to build internal champions.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity. You will be building the playbook as you go, not executing a mature one.
  • You are comfortable with commercial conversations, including engagement scoping, pricing input, and ensuring delivery commitments are realistic.
  • Familiarity with data and AI platforms and the enterprise adoption challenges they create.
  • A background in professional services, management consulting, or customer success is a plus.
  • Experience measuring behavior change tied to business value, not just completions or satisfaction scores, is a plus.

title: Principal Brand Content & AI Search Visibility
descriptionHtml:
MKTQ427R49

We're looking for a content lead who sits at the intersection of brand content storytelling and AI-era discoverability. You will own the creation of high-quality and high-volume brand content, ensuring that content is structured, distributed, and measured to win visibility across AI answer engines. You will produce and edit compelling content and employ optimization strategies to make sure LLMs discover, parse, and cite it. You will identify content gaps by analyzing where the brand is (and isn't) showing up in LLM answers, map those gaps against business objectives, target audiences, and product priorities, and orchestrate a mix of AI agents, technical writers, and internal teams to close them. A core part of this orchestration is overseeing a system of AI agents that create, optimize, and evaluate content — a task that requires real editorial expertise applied to prompt design and agent engineering, not just tool adoption. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the brand context, target prompts, and writing guidelines that guide agents and internal SMEs to create on-brand, accurate, and authoritative content. A major part of the role is editorial judgment: this includes reviewing drafts from agents and adjusting prompts and inputs to improve output quality.

The impact you will have:

Within 12–24 months in this role, success looks like:

  • The content roadmap is driven by evidence. You've stood up ongoing GEO/AI answer analysis, and every major content bet ties back to a documented gap — where the brand is underrepresented, inaccurate, or absent — requiring gap-analysis skills and fluency with GEO/AI-visibility diagnostics.
  • Business priorities and content output are in lockstep. The roadmap (blogs, video, web pages, thought leadership) is visibly built from business objectives, audience search intent, and product priorities, and stakeholders can trace any piece of content back to a prompt that justified it — requiring sharp prioritization judgment and the ability to translate business strategy into editorial direction.
  • A multi-resource content engine runs smoothly. Agencies, freelance contractors, internal writers/producers, and AI content agents are each matched to the content types they're best suited for; workflows include adequate content review, and handoffs don't create bottlenecks — all of which require strong orchestration and tool/vendor/contributor management skills.
  • Every piece of published content clears the bar you’ve set for that medium. You're the final editorial checkpoint on all content — agency, contractor, internal, or AI-generated — and your revision notes are specific enough to reliably lift drafts to brand standard, requiring proven editorial judgment across formats (long-form, blogs, video scripts, web copy).
  • Content is winning visibility and citation share. Published content is structured to be entity-rich, answer-first, well-sourced, and citation-worthy for LLM retrieval, without losing readability or brand voice — requiring hands-on GEO/AEO expertise layered on solid SEO and writing fundamentals.
  • Leadership can see the line from content to business outcome. You track GEO performance alongside traditional metrics and report on it regularly.
  • The broader marketing team writes and creates with GEO/AI-visibility in mind by default. You've enabled marketers across the org on GEO prompts and tools, AI writing agents, brand context, and best practices for quality writing.

What we look for:

  • 10+ years in content strategy, brand content, or editorial leadership, with experience managing a mix of internal and external contributors.
  • Strong editorial judgment — proven ability to review and elevate drafts across formats to a consistent brand standard.
  • Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals plus hands-on recent GEO/AEO experience — comfortable diagnosing why a brand isn't being cited or surfaced correctly by LLMs.
  • Experience managing agencies and/or freelance contractors, and comfort building and optimizing AI content tools/agents as part of a production workflow.
  • Familiarity with GEO/AI-visibility tools such as Profound, Conductor, AirOps, Peec.ai, or similar platforms.
  • Proficiency with Semrush, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics (GA4) to track technical optimization and brand visibility in traditional search engines. 
  • Sharp analytical instincts paired with strong creative/editorial taste.
  • Experience in B2B tech, data/AI, or enterprise SaaS.
  • Familiarity with schema markup and structured data for AI/search discoverability.
  • Experience overseeing video production workflows.

Within 12 months, grow our presence in priority publications, improve sentiment in competitive coverage, and build a portfolio of earned media wins tied to product launches, partnerships, and corporate news.

descriptionHtml:

The Role

As a Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA) – Data Engineering, you are a hands-on technical authority who guides strategic customers in designing, building, and optimizing production-grade data workloads on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. Partnering closely with Account Teams and Solution Architects, you translate complex big data challenges into high-performance, scalable architectures using Apache Spark™ and modern streaming frameworks. 

In this role, you will drive successful implementations, align technical roadmaps to accelerate platform adoption, and establish deep domain specialization; whether in real-time streaming, performance optimization, or operational data layers, while expanding your impact across Field Engineering.

The impact you will have:

  • Drive Technical Wins & Scope: Lead end-to-end technical design, proof of concepts (PoCs), and workload sizing for strategic customer engagements, acting as a trusted advisor to front-line technical stakeholders to secure technical wins.
  • Architect Production Data Systems: Design, build, and optimize scalable, high-performance batch and streaming pipelines, operational data layers (Lakebase), and end-to-end performance load testing on Databricks.
  • Deploy Interactive Data Applications: Build and operationalize custom user-facing data applications using Databricks Apps, transforming data pipelines and AI models into interactive tools.
  • AI-Native Engineering: Leverage AI coding assistants, LLMs, and agentic workflows (e.g., Genie Code, Cursor) as a force multiplier to rapidly prototype, debug, and deliver architectural assets with full ownership of outputs.
  • Enablement & Domain Leadership: Mentor peers, contribute reusable architecture assets, and deliver technical workshops and community presentations to scale expertise across accounts and field teams.

  • Deep Data Engineering Expertise: 5+ years in data or software engineering with hands-on proficiency in distributed processing (Apache Spark™, Delta Lake, SDP) and real-time streaming technologies (Spark Streaming, Kafka, CDC).
  • AI-First Builder Mindset: Demonstrated daily reliance on AI coding tools and LLMs to accelerate pipeline development, troubleshooting, and asset generation.
  • Production Programming & Foundations: Strong production coding skills in Python, SQL, and Scala or Java, with a solid grasp of data modeling and system design fundamentals.
  • Customer Advisory & Delivery: 5+ years in pre-sales or post-sales technical consulting, managing customer engagements and navigating multi-stakeholder technical discussions.
  • Operational & HTAP Architectures: Practical experience with operational/transactional data layers (Postgres/OLTP), low-latency serving, reverse ETL, and hybrid transactional/analytical processing.

title: Lead Solutions Architect – MedTech (Strategic Account)
descriptionHtml:
(FEQ128R42)

The Role

You will be the technical leader and lead architect for one of Databricks' most strategic global customers: a health technology company whose diagnostic, therapy, connected-care and consumer health products reach hundreds of millions of people every year. You will own the technical relationship and the Data + AI vision for a single complex enterprise that spans multiple business units, regions and regulatory regimes.

The account is a large, Azure-first Data Intelligence Platform customer. It runs a portfolio of well over a hundred use cases across business units and global functions, delivered as a multi-year program in quarterly releases. You will set the technical direction for that program and turn it into an executable roadmap. You will work as one team with the Account Executive and a dedicated pod of Solutions Architects, specialists, Professional Services and partners. We are looking for a visionary who can see where Data + AI will take health technology, explain that clearly to executives and engineers alike, and bring a large, distributed group of people with them!

The Impact You Will Have

Own and drive the technical vision

  • Define the customer's enterprise Data + AI vision with CxO and VP stakeholders, tied directly to business priorities. Be the executive suite's trusted advisor on platform strategy, build-vs-buy, responsible AI and regulated-industry governance.
  • Show, don't tell: inspire CTOs, chief architects and engineering leaders with working examples, and build prototypes yourself when it matters.
  • Lead the account pod technically: set direction for Solutions Architects, Specialist and Delivery SAs, Professional Services and partners, and coach them to raise the bar.
  • Partner with the Account Executive on account strategy and consumption planning, owning technical strategy and path to value for every major initiative.
  • Align pre-sales, delivery and partners so the customer sees one Databricks team, one plan and one escalation path, local to global. Lead discovery and solution design for strategic, high-risk deployments, driving each to production and measurable outcomes.
  • Build lasting C-level, VP and Director relationships across IT, data & AI, R&D, Quality & Regulatory, Service, Operations and the business units.
  • Be the customer's voice internally, shaping Databricks product and go-to-market strategy with field insight while leading the account's largest modernisation programs
  • Scale GenAI and agentic AI from pilot to production across business units.
  • Build partner ecosystem relationships (GSIs, ISVs, hyperscalers) to scale delivery.
  • Create reusable IP (reference designs, accelerators, talks, blogs) for the wider Databricks health and life sciences community.

What We Look For

(Note: it is not expected that you “tick every box” below and encourage you to apply if you are meeting several of the key criteria and can demonstrate a strong ability to transfer skills and develop quickly in the role!)  

  • Proven record as lead technical figure on a large global enterprise account, or as enterprise/chief architect at a similar organisation, owning the vision over multiple years.
  • Experience leading virtual teams without direct authority: setting direction, coaching senior architects and aligning specialists, delivery and partners on one plan.
  • Thrives with high autonomy in ambiguous, high-stakes, multi-region, multi-business-unit environments. Excellent communicator, from boardroom to engineering floor, with clear written thinking.

Technical depth

  • 10+ years in data engineering, analytics, ML or AI architecture, with significant customer-facing technical leadership (pre-sales, consulting or enterprise architecture).
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in modern data and AI platforms; Apache Spark, Delta Lake and Databricks experience is a strong plus.
  • Experience designing:
    • Large-scale data platforms and migrations from legacy warehouses, Hadoop or other clouds
    • Enterprise governance and security models
    • Production ML, MLOps, GenAI and agent systems
  • Proven ability to win platform decisions against hyperscaler-native and competing platforms on architecture, cost and governance.
  • Proficient in Python and SQL; able to prototype quickly, including with AI-assisted development.

Domain knowledge

  • Experience in health technology, medical devices, life sciences or another regulated industry, and a passion for improving patient outcomes with Data + AI.
  • Understanding of privacy and data-sharing regimes (GDPR, HIPAA, European Health Data Space). Familiarity with healthcare data standards (DICOM, HL7, FHIR, OMOP).

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity working in or with MedTech and medical AI regulation, with examples such as: EU MDR/IVDR, FDA SaMD, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971
  • Experience designing validated, audit-ready (GxP / 21 CFR Part 11) data and AI environments. Enterprise-scale SAP data integration (BW, S/4HANA) and semantic harmonisation.
  • Public thought leadership: conference talks, publications or open source.
  • Dutch is a plus; professional English required.

title: Technical Business Development Manager, Startup & VC Ecosystem
descriptionHtml:
RDQ427R630

This role is in-person and Bay-Area-based by design, so you can be in the room with founders and investors.

At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high-value challenges central to their missions. Founded in 2013 by the original creators of Apache Spark™, Databricks has grown from a tiny corner office in Berkeley, CA, to a global organization with over 11,000 employees. Thousands of organizations, from small startups to Fortune 100, trust Databricks with their mission-critical workloads, making us one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the world and one of the top 5 most valuable private companies.

About the Role:

Databricks works with founders from the earliest days of their companies, when it is still just a team, an idea, and a lot of unproven AI. The Technical Business Development Manager for the Startup and VC Ecosystem owns the operational engine and the relationships behind that work, and the role is technical. You will run our startup program day to day, sit across from early-stage founders and talk seriously about their AI systems, produce a steady cadence of founder and investor events in San Francisco, and work hand in hand with the events teams at the venture firms whose founders we most want to reach. You will work closely with Databricks Ventures. This role is built to grow: you will start close to the program, the founders, and the events, and over time, take on more of the relationships and the strategy for how Databricks engages the startup ecosystem end-to-end.

This role asks for four things that rarely sit in one person: the discipline of an operator who tracks every applicant and commitment without dropping one, the hands of a builder who is genuinely fluent in AI and can talk to a founder as a peer, the ease of someone who earns the trust of founders and the partners at the best venture firms in the country, and the judgment to turn all of that into strategy for how Databricks wins the next generation of companies. Most strong candidates have two of these, and some have three. We are hiring for trajectory: you should already be strong in the operating and the building, and hungry to grow into relationships and strategy. This is one of the rare seats where operating, building, and relationship-building are the same job. 

The impact you will have: 

  • Run the startup program: Own the day-to-day operations of the program, including applicant intake, evaluation, scoring, routing, and offer decisions, with precise tracking of every applicant, commitment, and outcome. Run it on AI automation built with Databricks AI tooling such as Omnigent, Unity Gateway, Agent Bricks, etc. Strong, hands-on proficiency with these tools is a requirement, not just knowing your way around them.
  • Bring programmatic discipline: Own the trackers, the automation, the quality bar, and the follow-through so that nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Be technical with founders: Hold real technical conversations with early-stage founders about their models, agents, data, and automation, and where Databricks and Neon fit. Earn their trust by being credible on the technology, not by pitching.
  • Build and prototype: Build the automation and internal tooling that runs the program, and stay hands-on with the same AI tools founders use, so you can assess their technical ideas from a place of experience. This is developer relations at its most technical: close to the code and close to the builders.
  • Assess and translate: Assess each founder's technical capability and the strength of their idea, and carry what you learn back to Product and to Databricks Ventures.
  • Run founder and investor events: Design and run a regular calendar of founder and investor gatherings in San Francisco, including dinners, workshops, office hours, and demo-day tie-ins. Partner with the events and platform teams at leading venture firms to co-produce these gatherings, and build durable relationships with those teams that deepen over time.
  • Represent Databricks in the ecosystem: Show up as a founder-first, technically credible presence at founder and investor events, and grow into being one of the faces of Databricks across the venture community.
  • Grow into ownership: Work alongside Databricks Ventures on how we engage founders across the full arc of their journey, from a first look at their technology and ideas to whatever they build next, and grow into broader ownership of the startup function as you build trust and results.

What we look for: 

This is a rare combination, and we know it. We are hiring for trajectory as much as for a finished resume: the strongest candidates are already strong on the first three and eager to grow into the rest.

  • Genuinely technical with AI. You build. You can prototype an automation, reason about an agent architecture, and get into the details of a founder's stack without hand-waving.
  • A programmatic operator with an obsessive eye for detail. You run complex, multi-track programs without dropping a thread.
  • The developer-relations instinct. You earn credibility with builders by being one, and you can explain and teach hard technical ideas clearly.
  • Comfortable around early-stage founders and investors, and ready to build relationships with top venture firms, starting with their events teams and growing toward their partners.
  • Experience helping design and run events that people actually want to attend.
  • Comfort switching between hands-on technical work, operational execution, and strategic thinking in the same day.
  • Based in San Francisco. This role requires regular in-person time with founders and investors in the Bay Area.
  • Empathy for founders and a long view of their careers. You understand that a founder's first company is rarely their last.
  • Nice to have: a background as a founder, an early engineer, or a forward-deployed or solutions engineer; experience in B2B SaaS, AI and data infrastructure, or developer ecosystems.

title: Lead Solutions Architect - Generative AI (EMEA Emerging DNB)
descriptionHtml:
REQ ID: FEQ227R147

Location: Sweden (Remote/Hybrid) - will require travel across Europe

Recruiter: Dina Hussain

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.

You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.
  • Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.
  • Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.
  • Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.
  • Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.
  • Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.
  • Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.
  • Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.
  • Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).
  • Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.
  • Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.
  • A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.
  • Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.
  • Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.
  • Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.

Nice to Have

  • Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.
  • Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.

Why This Role

You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.

About Databricks

More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Solutions Architect - Adtech
descriptionHtml:
FEQ427R799

The Role

As a Solutions Architect, you will lead the technical strategy for your customers — owning architecture discussions, driving platform adoption, and serving as a trusted advisor to customer technical leads and architects. You combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to position Databricks as the foundation of your customers’ data and AI strategy. You are developing a technical specialization (archetype) and are recognized within your team for depth in a specific domain.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Own the end-to-end technical strategy for your accounts, from initial discovery through production deployment and consumption growth
  • Lead complex architecture discussions — designing scalable, production-grade solutions spanning data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer architects, engineering leads, and Directors
  • Drive technical wins in competitive scenarios by demonstrating Databricks’ differentiation through custom-built solutions
  • Develop and declare an emerging technical specialization (archetype) — becoming a go-to resource for your team in that domain
  • Orchestrate cross-functional resources (DSAs, SSAs, Partners) to deliver comprehensive solutions for complex customer needs
  • Influence product direction by providing structured feedback on customer requirements and competitive gaps

What We Look For

  • 6+ years in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role
  • Strong coding proficiency in Python and SQL — you must demonstrate live coding, debugging, and solution-building skills
  • Deep expertise in distributed data systems architecture: designing scalable pipelines, streaming architectures, lakehouse patterns, and cloud-native data platforms
  • Proficient on the Databricks Platform (or demonstrated ability to achieve proficiency rapidly) with a developing technical specialization in one area (e.g., real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, migrations)
  • Proven ability to lead architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders — whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off analysis
  • Experience with production deployments on public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including infrastructure, security, and governance considerations
  • Track record of driving platform adoption and consumption growth within accounts
  • Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex architectures into business value for both technical and executive audiences
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience)

Nice to Have:

  • Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, Platform)
  • Experience with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) — understanding the landscape you'll position against
  • Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider
  • Industry domain expertise (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Media, etc.)

Interview Process: Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design and Architecture Interview → Live Coding Assessment → Build, Demo, Pitch! Presentation → Reference Check

About Databricks

Manager, Delivery Solutions Architect  – Healthcare & Life Sciences (HLS)

United States – Apply Now

As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA) Manager supporting our Healthcare & Life Sciences (HLS) segment, you will lead a team of DSAs responsible for accelerating production-grade Data and AI workloads across some of the most regulated, mission-critical environments in the world. Your organization will be the technical engine behind how payers, providers, med-tech, and biopharma customers modernize clinical intelligence, streamline R&D operations, and operationalize secure AI at scale on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

You will define strategy, set the execution rhythm, and coach a team capable of navigating long implementation cycles, strict compliance requirements, and multi-stakeholder enterprise programs—all while ensuring customers achieve clear, measurable outcomes. You will report to the Director of Delivery Solutions Architecture for the HLS Business Unit.

The Impact You Will Have:

Build and Lead a High-Performing HLS Delivery Team

Hire, develop, and inspire DSAs who can navigate clinical, scientific, and operational workloads. Establish a performance culture grounded in accuracy, velocity, and architectural excellence.

Accelerate Production in Highly Regulated Environments

Guide your team to minimize onboarding friction, remove blockers, and bring critical HLS use cases—clinical analytics, real-world evidence, supply-chain intelligence, quality systems, AI/ML—into production quickly and safely.

Drive Compliance-Aware Technical Excellence

Ensure your team maintains deep expertise in the Data Intelligence Platform alongside core HLS requirements such as PHI-compliant architectures, HIPAA/GxP controls, auditability, lineage, and secure ML/AI operations.

Partner for Growth With Sales and Field Teams

Collaborate tightly with Sales, SAs, Support, Emerging Technologies, and Professional Services to drive adoption, increase MAU/WAU, enable mature operational patterns, and ensure customers realize tangible business value from Databricks.

Operationalize Rigor at Scale

Establish forecasting mechanisms, production readiness criteria, customer health indicators, and consumption execution frameworks that ensure predictable, multi-account delivery across HLS programs.

Be the Executive-Facing Technical Sponsor

Engage with IT, security, clinical, R&D, and data executives to shape modernization roadmaps, influence architectural direction, mitigate risk, and sponsor the strategic value of Lakehouse and GenAI across the HLS ecosystem.

Strengthen and Evolve the DSA Practice

Contribute to cross-BU initiatives that enhance delivery quality, reproducibility, and reuse—including patterns, accelerators, reference architectures, and playbooks tailored for healthcare, biopharma, and payer/provider operations.

What We Look For

  • 8+ years in customer-facing technical roles (Architecture, Field Engineering, Consulting), with 3+ years leading or managing technical teams.

  • Demonstrated success enabling production workloads in regulated industries, ideally with HLS, life sciences, or similar GxP/HIPAA-bound environments.

  • Deep knowledge of cloud-native Lakehouse architectures, data governance, secure ML operations, and enterprise migration/modernization patterns.

  • Hands-on, executive-credible expertise in SQL, Python/Scala, distributed data systems, code reviews, and solution architecture.

  • Strong track record guiding customers through ETL modernization, analytics, real-time/streaming, and AI/ML productionization.

  • Experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including IAM, network security, compliance controls, and data perimeter models.

  • Proven ability to manage escalations, forecast usage growth, operationalize delivery frameworks, and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong executive presence—trusted advisor to CIOs, CISOs, Chief Data Officers, Clinical/R&D executives, and enterprise technical leaders.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Willingness to travel up to 30%.

title: Delivery Solutions Architect - Public Sector (DOW, DHS, Intelligence Community)
descriptionHtml:
CSQ427R318

PLEASE NOTE:
Due to federal contract requirements and client site access obligations, U.S. citizenship is required to access classified information. 

Location: Remote (East Coast-based) with up to 30% Travel 

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks Platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability for our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage of Databricks workloads they have already selected, helping them maximize the value they get from our platform and their return on investment.

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel with being technical, with the expectation that you become the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to utilize your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate effectively with all levels of an organization. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization. 

The impact you will have:

  • Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritized customers
  • Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
  • Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live, and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
  • Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to the production/go-live status of agreed-upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
  • Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, and Support resources, along with escalating to expert-level technical experts, to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
  • Create, own, and execute a point-of-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
  • Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews, and upgrade needs
  • Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:
    • Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
    • Enablement/user growth plan
    • Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
    • Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
    • Executive and operational governance
  • Provide internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression - to your Technical GM

What we look for:

  • U.S. citizenship 
  • 7+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project/program delivery within the domain of Data and AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers 
  • Programming experience in Python, SQL, or Scala 
  • Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role 
  • Understanding of solution architecture related to distributed data systems
  • Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
  • Technical program or project management, including account, stakeholder, and resource management accountability
  • Experience in resolving complex and important escalations with senior customer executives
  • Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops,  creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
  • Track record of overachievement against quota, goals, or similar objective targets
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
  • Can travel up to 30% when needed

Pay Range Transparency

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles.  Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here.

More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
CSQ128R182

Databricks is redefining what organisations can achieve with data and AI. As the unified platform powering the world's most ambitious data-driven enterprises, we sit at the intersection of cloud migrations, AI transformation, and real-time intelligence and our customers challenge us every day to go further.

As Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering, you will lead a high-performing team of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) at the forefront of this transformation. Partnering with Databricks' most strategic enterprise customers, you will shape how leading organisations migrate to the lakehouse, build next-generation AI and GenAI systems, and unlock sustained business value from their data investments.

As a people leader, you will build and scale a team that represents Databricks' highest standard of technical excellence and customer impact. Your team will partner with enterprises across industries to architect and deliver mission-critical solutions, from large-scale data migrations and legacy modernisation programs to cutting-edge generative AI, MLOps, and AI agent deployments. You will set the bar for delivery quality, grow world-class talent, and drive the strategic governance framework that ensures every engagement is executed with precision and measurable impact.

The impact you will have:

  • Oversee regional performance targets, including billable utilisation, team growth, and hiring, while championing delivery excellence and customer success across the FDE portfolio.
  • Partner with Account Executives, Engagement Managers, and Field Engineering leaders to position, scope, and deliver transformational Professional Services (PS) programs spanning data migrations, AI/ML platforms, and advanced analytics.
  • Establish best practices for project oversight, risk management, and quality standards that scale with a growing FDE practice, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to specification.
  • Synthesise field insights from your team’s engagements to provide direct feedback to Engineering and Product management, helping to guide the Databricks roadmap while driving the creation of reusable customer accelerators and frameworks.
  • Serve as the critical escalation point for high-stakes customer situations, leveraging deep technical credibility and leadership judgment to protect strategic relationships and drive rapid resolution.
  • Mentor Forward Deployed Engineers through structured career pathways, technical coaching, and a culture of innovation, mastery, and continuous growth.

What we look for:

  • Key requirements

    • 4+ years leading high-performing technical delivery teams, with a proven track record building excellence-driven cultures
    • 5+ years as a technical solutions architect or data/AI engineer, providing coaching credibility
    • Familiarity with Databricks, Apache Spark™, MLflow, Delta Lake, or the modern data and AI ecosystem
    • Consulting / professional services background with a hands-on technical foundation
    • Proven technical depth to personally build with AI, coach teams with best practices, drive organisation-wide adoption
    • Demonstrated success leading large-scale data platform migrations and AI/ML programs in enterprise environments
    • Strong understanding of technical project delivery, including scope, timelines, and SOW management
    • Strong stakeholder management skills navigating complex, high-stakes customer environments
    • Ability to travel to customer sites approximately 20% of the time

    Nice-to-Haves

    • Prior experience at a hyperscaler (Google, AWS, Azure) or a top data/AI company
    • An in-house/industry stint alongside vendor-side delivery experience

title: Enterprise Sales Director, Retail
descriptionHtml:
SLSQ427R975

Do you want to help solve the world's toughest problems with big data and AI? This is what we do every day at Databricks!

Leading a team of Enterprise Named and Strategic Account Executives, that are passionate about solving the toughest problems for Retailers and Grocers, and drive value for our customers.

You will oversee the Retail senior sales team, implementing sales plans, expanding existing business and delivering accurate sales forecasting and reporting. 

This is a fantastic opportunity to build upon a highly successful team achieving significant year on year growth, in a fast growing business which is hugely impactful part of the UKI sales organisation. We are looking for owners, who will go the extra mile and want to be the very best at what they do.

The position will report directly to the RVP, Consumer Industries, UK and Ireland 

The impact you will have:

  • Lead a team of account executives, ensuring you coach them to develop the skills and behaviours they will need to succeed
  • Build the GTM for the Retail and Grocery, UK and Ireland 
  • Establish company territory plans, team structure, individual quotas and patches for your team, including investment capacity requirements
  • Report on revenue forecast and strategic GTM programs
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to manage a complete revenue and customer success process
  • Inspire a culture of teamwork, leading with value and achieving desired customers outcomes
  • Develop trust-based relationships with customers and partners to ensure long-term success
  • Encourage learning and ongoing understanding of technical product details and our future product roadmap
  • Establish a revenue growth and investment plan in the first 90 days
  • Deliver our strategic growth plans, in collaboration with the other function leaders across EMEA, ensure forecast accuracy and a predictable, high-growth business 

What we look for:

  • Experience as a high-growth enterprise software sales leader with experience leading sales teams serving Named and Strategic customers in UKI within the Data, AI, Cloud, or SaaS Sales Industry
  • Experience within the Retail vertical 
  • History of exceeding sales quotas in similar high-growth technology companies

descriptionHtml:

At Databricks, our core values are at the heart of everything we do; a culture of proactivity and a customer-centric mindset guide us in creating a unified platform that makes Data Engineering, Data Science, Analytics & GenAI accessible to everyone. You have declared your archetype - a recognised technical specialisation that makes you a force multiplier across your team and region. You operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise, strategic account planning, and executive influence.

This role will report to a Field Engineering Manager in the Emerging Enterprises team.

title: Emerging Enterprise Core Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Emerging Business, Canada | Toronto, ON (Calgary, Vancouver and Montreal considered)

About the role

As an Emerging Enterprise Account Executive at Databricks, you'll own a book of 10 to 20 mid-sized Canadian companies that are already building on Databricks. These are enterprises and growth companies that are modernizing their data platforms and putting AI from POC to Production. 

You'll run the full sales cycle yourself, from discovery through close, with a dedicated Solutions Architect as your technical partner. You're expected to talk to a data engineering lead in the morning and a VP of Finance in the afternoon, and be credible in both conversations. This is a consumption-based role. Signing the contract is only part of the job. You're measured on whether customers actually use what they buy.

You'll report to the Sales Director, Emerging Business Canada, and work alongside Startup and Geo AEs on a team that covers everything from Series A startups to established Canadian enterprises.

The impact you will have

  • Build a territory and account plan within your first 30 days that ranks your accounts by consumption potential and names your top use case targets.
  • Grow consumption across your book by finding new workloads and teams, then partnering with your SA to move use cases from scoping to production.
  • Close commit deals on your own, from first-time Jumpstart commits to multi-year agreements, and bring in your manager and deal desk on the more complex ones.
  • Build net new pipeline every quarter through prospecting and account development. 
  • Build Business Value Assessments and ROI cases that tie Databricks to outcomes your buyer's CFO and Line of Business leaders cares about.
  • Own customer relationships up to the C level, and go beyond the technical buyer into lines of business.
  • Lead customer use case delivery with Professional Services and partners (GSIs, AWS, Azure, GCP) to keep implementations on schedule.
  • Forecast accurately. Keep Salesforce, use case stages, and MEDDPICC current so your forecast holds up on a call.
  • Use AI tools every day for account research, call prep, outreach, and pipeline management, so you can spend more time with customers.

What we look for

  • 3+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying B2B sales experience, ideally in data, cloud, AI, or SaaS infrastructure
  • A track record of meeting or beating quota, with deals you can walk through in detail: who the buyer was, what you found in discovery, how you structured it, and why it closed
  • Experience growing existing accounts and landing new business in the same territory
  • Comfort with consumption or usage-based models, or a clear understanding of how they differ from seat-based licensing
  • Enough technical depth to run a standard product demo, sketch a basic cloud data architecture, and know when to bring in your SA
  • Experience selling to business stakeholders and executives, not only technical teams
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your current sales process. We'll ask you to show us how you use them.
  • Experience working with partners such as cloud providers, GSIs, or ISVs as part of how you run deals
  • Resilience, curiosity, and coachability. You take feedback, change your approach, and keep going when a deal stalls.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar qualification framework
