title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, AI Runtime
descriptionHtml:
P-1096

At Databricks, we run the world's largest AI platform. We believe the next breakthroughs will come from models trained on domain-specific enterprise data, not from bigger general-purpose models alone.

That's why we built AI Runtime, a serverless product that makes GPU training of any size feel simple, so companies can train their own models the way frontier labs do. Customers across industries train on it, right next to the enterprise data already in Databricks. Among them are Rivian in automotive, Robinhood in fintech, and Merck, which builds foundation models for drug discovery. Our own AI researchers use it to post-train models with hundreds of billions to nearly a trillion parameters.

It takes a lot of engineering to make that work, and we've written about it on our blog: how we keep GPUs reliable, make training fault-tolerant, and speed up fine-tuning with fused kernels and smart sequence packing. AI agents now launch experiments too, and on our research team they've already increased training jobs 8x.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you'll work on the systems behind all of this, solving the hardest technical problems and shaping where AI Runtime goes next.

The impact you will have:

  • Drive AI Runtime's architecture and lead Databricks' long-term technical direction in AI training infrastructure.
  • Define the reliability and observability strategy for a fleet that keeps growing in scale and complexity.
  • Shape AI Runtime's developer experience for people and agents, so even the largest training jobs feel as simple as a first experiment.
  • Anticipate industry trends and choose the technical bets that prepare AI Runtime for new GPU generations and workload types.
  • Take on the hardest multi-node training problems yourself, from orchestration and GPU scheduling to data loading and checkpointing.
  • Make training faster and cheaper by raising efficiency across model architectures and GPU accelerators.
  • Work with research, product, and customers to decide what we build next and align teams on hard technical calls.
  • Champion engineering excellence, raise the bar, and help us hire and grow great engineers.

What we look for:

  • 15+ years in large-scale distributed systems, with significant depth in GPU training, high-performance computing, or ML systems.
  • Hands-on experience training large models with FSDP, DeepSpeed, or Megatron, and fluency in parallelism strategies.
  • Expertise in GPU performance, including accelerator architecture, high-speed interconnects, and kernels.
  • Strong understanding of training resilience patterns, such as checkpointing, failure detection, and automatic recovery.
  • A background in building and running multi-tenant cloud platforms as products.
  • A track record of setting technical direction across teams and seeing it through to business impact.
  • The credibility to bring teams to agreement on difficult trade-offs, and a reputation as a mentor senior engineers seek out.
  • BS in Computer Science or a related field (MS or PhD preferred).

FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specifications with exceptional customer empathy.

Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer

title: Lead Counsel,  Strategic Alliances
descriptionHtml:
GAQ128R4

Location:  We're hiring for this role locally to our offices based in Seattle or Bellevue, San Francisco, or Mountain View. This will be a hybrid role with in-office expectations. 

Databricks is looking for a talented and experienced Lead Counsel to support strategic technology partnerships and other specialty initiatives.  This position offers a unique opportunity to play a leading role in providing business-focused legal support for some of the most strategic and complex matters fueling Databricks' growth.  

You will report to the VP & Associate General Counsel, Strategic Alliances & Integration 

Strategic partnerships are an essential pillar to Databricks' providing the world's leading data & AI platform, integrating the broadest range of the latest leading technologies from proven partner providers. In this role, you will work closely with Databricks Strategic Alliances and cross-functional stakeholders, orchestrating advice and contributions across internal and external experts, and innovating to provide solutions in a rapidly evolving landscape. 

A successful candidate will have deep proven experience navigating and negotiating complex, highly operational agreements with technology partners, including leading AI Model Providers and global hyperscalers, working with a wide range of internal stakeholders at all levels, including regular direct engagement with senior leadership. You must be an agile, resourceful self-starter, comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, and excellent at building strong relationships and giving clear, pragmatic advice.  You have a bias for action, enjoy building, thrive on finding creative solutions to new challenges, and value seeing your direct impact on the business.  

The impact you will have:

  • Lead and manage all legal aspects of selected Strategic Alliance technology transactions, including term sheet negotiations, running deal processes and negotiations, reviewing, drafting, and negotiating documents, securing and coordinating engagement and contributions from cross-functional stakeholders, including Product, Finance, Security, Procurement, Commercial Legal, Product Legal, GTM Legal, and other internal and external experts
  • Facilitate closing of agreements, coordinating with Corporate Legal and Finance for Board approvals where needed, provide expert legal guidance and business-focused advice to clients, cross-functional teams, and leadership throughout the strategic deal process, while ensuring compliance with internal policies and applicable laws and regulations, and addressing integration and advisory issues arising post-signing within Legal and across the company
  • Drive or provide legal support for other strategic transactions or projects, including collaborating in developing new partnering motions, and developing new processes and templates to scale our strategic partner practice

What we look for:

  • You have at least 10 years of experience at a nationally recognized law firm and / or in-house legal department at a high-tech company
  • You have a J.D. from a top-tier law school, and are a Member of a state bar in good standing
  • You understand AI/foundation model platform technology and related contract models, and have deep experience partnering around both open source and proprietary technologies, and cloud or data-platform product partnerships
  • You have familiarity with open source licensing models (e.g., Apache 2.0, MIT, model-specific community licenses) and their use with open weight models
  • You are fluent in various partnering models, including OEM, resale, and marketplace-driven transactions, and related quote-to-cash implications
  • You are comfortable and enjoy partnering directly with cross-functional teams to understand, incorporate, and enforce operational requirements in our partnership structures
  • You are a critical thinker comfortable in speaking up and brainstorming productively, with a demonstrated ability to convey complex legal concepts clearly and concisely, thinking of future needs/issues, while executing on current activities. 
  • You have a programmatic mindset, experience managing multi-faceted projects, and an understanding of how to develop and simplify processes. 
  • You apply a highly collaborative and positive approach to working with legal colleagues and business partners, building strong relationships with internal stakeholders across geos and functions to ensure effective communication and collaboration.

title: Sr. Counsel, Employment
descriptionHtml:
GAQ427R247

Primary location(s) preferred, but candidates based in SF, Mountain View, NYC, Boston, Chicago, or Denver will also be considered.

What we look for:

The Senior Counsel, Employment will provide sophisticated, practical legal advice to the Databricks People Team and business leaders, with a particular focus on HR AI adoption, compensation and benefits, pay equity, global mobility, employee privacy, and M&A (diligence, employee-related deal terms, and workforce integration). This person will be based in the U.S. and advise directly on U.S. matters, but will also lead and project-manage complex global projects. Regular cross-functional partners will include recruiting, privacy and product legal, security, tax, people operations, comp and benefits, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will be a pragmatic and resourceful advisor and an enthusiastic AI user, with strong project-management discipline and the ability to move quickly while maintaining a high standard of legal and operational precision. In addition to the focus areas above, this person will collaborate to resolve U.S. disputes.

This is a full-time position reporting to Databricks' Senior Director and Associate General Counsel of Global Employment Legal and working closely with a team of employment lawyers and legal professionals across multiple regions.

Responsibilities

  • Advise on cash compensation programs, bonus and incentive plans, clawback policies, equal-pay requirements, pay equity reviews, compensation governance, and related internal and external disclosures. Lead or support pay equity projects, including scoping, data and process review, coordination with stakeholders, review of analyses, and development of remediation or communication plans.
  • Provide legal advice on employee benefits, including retirement plans, welfare and wrap plans, severance plans, leave-related benefits, and country-specific benefits and protections, partnering with benefits counsel and regional employment legal team members as appropriate.
  • Draft, review, and update employment-related plans, policies, agreements, templates, and employee communications with exceptional precision and attention to detail.
  • Advise recruiting and talent acquisition teams on candidate-facing issues, offer letters, employment agreements, compensation terms, background checks, hiring practices, and negotiations, often on time-sensitive matters.
  • Advise on global mobility and immigration matters, including employee transfers, international assignments, work authorization, permanent residence processes, employer-of-record and professional-employer-organization arrangements, cross-border moves, and related onboarding or exit issues.
  • Support the employment-related aspects of mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments, including employment and benefits diligence, workforce mapping, employee-related deal terms, retention and vesting arrangements, transition and separation arrangements, and post-closing workforce integration.
  • Advise on employee privacy and data-use issues, including employee and candidate data, access and disclosure requests, workforce technology, monitoring, data transfers, and the employment implications of business and HR systems.
  • Review and advise on HR AI tools and workflows, including vendor diligence, recruiting, use-case design, employment-law and privacy risks, bias and discrimination considerations, governance controls, documentation, and responsible implementation.
  • Lead global employment-related projects, including international expansions, from scoping through implementation, including developing workplans, identifying stakeholders and dependencies, coordinating regional counsel and outside advisors, managing timelines and budgets, documenting decisions, and driving issues to resolution.
  • Monitor legal developments affecting compensation, benefits, pay equity, recruiting, mobility, privacy, AI, and other relevant employment areas, and translate those developments into practical guidance, process changes, and training for internal clients.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that help the Legal and People Teams scale, including playbooks, decision frameworks, repeatable workflows, knowledge-management practices, and automated or AI-enabled solutions.
  • Serve as a hands-on problem solver for sensitive, high-priority, and cross-functional issues, exercising sound judgment about when to escalate matters to legal leadership or engage specialized counsel.
  • Respond to U.S. demand letters, administrative charges, and other disputes, including investigating claims, communicating with opposing counsel, negotiating resolutions, and drafting separation and settlement agreements.

Qualifications & Experience Required

  • JD from a top-tier law school; member of a state bar in good standing.
  • 10+ years of relevant employment-law experience, with substantial experience advising sophisticated organizations; in-house experience, including firm secondee experience, strongly preferred.
  • Experience with compensation, benefits, pay equity, executive compensation, recruiting, global mobility, and immigration.
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments, including employment and benefits diligence, employee-related deal terms, and workforce integration.
  • Experience leading multi-jurisdictional or global projects and coordinating stakeholders across regions, functions, and levels of seniority.
  • Experience advising on employee privacy, workforce data, HR technology, and AI tools is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional drafting skills, including the ability to produce precise, clear, audience-appropriate agreements, policies, memoranda, guidance, and executive communications.
  • Strong project-management skills, including the ability to define scope, create structure from ambiguity, manage dependencies, maintain momentum, and deliver high-quality work on deadline.
  • Ability to quickly and independently assess unfamiliar or time-sensitive situations, identify the material risks, and develop practical options to resolve them.
  • Ability to build strong relationships quickly and work effectively with executive stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, high-growth technology company and to make progress with incomplete information.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and emerging technology.
  • Client-service orientation, a bias for action, and the highest level of integrity and business ethics.

title: Sr. Sales Compensation Analyst
descriptionHtml:
GAQ128R88

As a Sr. Sales Compensation Analyst on the Comp Admin team, you will run commissions administration from start to finish for a large global group of sellers, so they can trust that they are paid accurately and on time. You will own a large payee portfolio with no supervision needed, from plan rollout through calculation, payroll, and follow-up support. You will catch issues before they reach the field and keep every step audit-ready. You will also use AI and automation every day to make our work faster, more accurate, and easier to scale as Databricks grows.

The impact you will have:

  • Own commissions administration for a large payee portfolio with no errors: user setup, plan distribution, input processing, calculation, and payment.
  • Deliver plan rollout and payout accurately and on time every cycle, including tracking ICPW acceptance and preparing data that feeds payroll and accounting deadlines.
  • Resolve payee and partner questions quickly and fully, so issues are settled the first time without escalations. Run rep training and enablement sessions as needed.
  • Keep your portfolio fully compliant with SOX and audit requirements by following controls with discipline, documenting clearly, and keeping evidence reproducible.
  • Find discrepancies, exceptions, and control gaps early (for example, wrong credits, quota mismatches, or cap and accelerator errors), trace the root cause in the data, and drive the fix with Sales Ops, Payroll, and Accounting.
  • Make recurring workflows faster, more reliable, and easier to repeat by improving documentation, simplifying handoffs, and cutting rework.
  • Use AI to improve recurring work such as validations, reconciliations, and responses to comp questions. Build repeatable approaches that others on the team can adopt.
  • Help the team grow by mentoring new hires on tools, processes, and best practices, and by referring strong candidates.

What we look for:

  • 5+ years of hands-on sales compensation administration, including user setup, plan distribution, calculation and payment, comp questions, and rep training.
  • Advanced Xactly skills, including administration, reporting, and troubleshooting, with the ability to resolve system issues on your own.
  • Advanced Excel and Google Workspace skills for complex modeling, data analysis, and reconciliation.
  • A solid grasp of SaaS go-to-market compensation models (commit vs. consumption, quotas, OTI, accelerators, overlays, SPIFFs, MBOs) and how plan mechanics shape seller behavior.
  • Experience working under SOX or similar audit controls, with accurate, well-documented work and clean audit trails.
  • Strong analytical judgment: you investigate patterns, find root causes, and turn data into practical recommendations.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Databricks bills customers on usage. Every month, millions of usage records turn into commit drawdowns, invoices and revenue. The Revenue Operations team within Order to Cash organization makes sure that happens accurately and on time.

We’re hiring a Revenue Operations Manager to oversee  usage operations and improve how contracts move from booking to invoicing. A key focus is Universal Commitment, our cloud-agnostic commit model. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Revenue Operations, you’ll lead key month-end close activities for our billing and rating platform, oversee a team based in India, and drive process and automation improvements across Revenue Operations. 

You'll work closely with the Order to Revenue Process Compliance team. That team sets usage policy, leads root-cause analysis and owns governance. Your team carries out the work: applying adjustments, keeping usage and billing in balance, and making sure each correction is documented, reviewed and fully reflected in our systems.

What you'll do

Revenue operations and contract setup

  • Own the booking review process. Validate orders in the booking queue and serve as the escalation point for upstream teams on complex contract structures.
  • Make sure contract and usage settings are correct across our billing and rating platform, ERP and CPQ, so that Universal Commitment and other contract type invoice as intended.
  • Advise Deal Desk and Revenue Assurance on whether non-standard terms can be billed (e.g., GPU reservations, per-hour pricing, custom SKUs) before deals close. Provide guidance on new product offerings and ensure operational feasibility prior to finance sign off.
  • Define and report Revenue Operations KPIs, such as adjustment volume, close timeliness, and billing accuracy.

Usage operations and adjustments

  • Oversee and approve usage adjustments, billing corrections and customer credits in DBAR and the ERP. This covers billing errors, SLA credits and customer satisfaction (CSAT) credits, in line with Usage Compliance policies and approval levels.
  • Serve as the escalation point for manual usage processing, including manual usage uploads, reservation and non-standard billing, ledger entries, and retract-and-restate corrections, with a full audit trail.
  • Make sure usage-to-contract mapping, including customer workspace moves, PAYG-to-commit conversions and mid-term contract changes, with the correct effective dates.
  • Act as the Revenue Operations owner of the refund and credit process, from intake, and validation through execution.
  • Approve or deny account provisioning requests (suspend, unsuspend, grace-period extensions) with the Network Operations Center (NOC).
  • Oversee usage tracking for customers with special provisions and non-standard language in their order form.

Month-end and quarter-end close

  • Lead our contract reconciliation which ingests and compares usage across all clouds at the contractual level. Partner with Engineering, from pre-close through delivery of the final usage file to Revenue Accounting .
  • Run usage categorization and commit and PAYG reconciliations, between the billing platform and the ERP across all clouds.
  • Own billing finalization (Billing Mass Finalization / ledger freeze), the step that closes each month.
  • Partner with the Revenue Accounting on  usage flux analysis and contribute to  shorten the close timeline.
  • Act as preparer and/or reviewer for assigned SOX controls (e.g., usage reconciliation and SKU pricing accuracy) and keep audit evidence ready.Align with RevOps team to continue to improve recon process by assimilating processes across all clouds. Oversee Universal Commit contract reconciliation to ensure completeness.

Team leadership and scale

  • Lead and develop the GBS usage team (India). Set priorities, review work, and steadily expand team ownership.Write, maintain and centrally store SOPs for every recurring process, and make sure each critical close task has a trained backup.
  • Use SQL and Databricks dashboards to automate reconciliations and reduce  manual effort, working toward touchless billing.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Partner with the Usage Compliance team. Hand off recurring adjustment patterns and supporting data for root-cause analysis, put new policies into practice, and report adjustment volume and status.
  • Work with the Money/DBAR Engineering, IT/Business Systems, Deal Desk, Billing, Collections and Revenue Accounting teams to resolve usage and billing issues quickly.
  • Serve as subject matter expert on strategic initiatives and projects by working with our commercialization team, engineering, and other GTM and Accounting teams. Will require driving project initiatives in certain cases.

What we're looking for

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related field.
  • 6+ years in revenue operations, billing operations or order-to-cash, ideally with usage- or consumption-based billing.
  • 2+ years managing people, including leading offshore or shared-service teams.
  • Hands-on experience with billing or rating systems and a major ERP (e.g., SAP, NetSuite or Oracle), plus Salesforce/CPQ.
  • Strong SQL skills. Experience with Databricks is a plus.
  • Track record of running month-end close tasks on time, with SOX controls.
  • Experience leading or guiding offshore or shared-services teams.
  • Clear written communication and a habit of documenting your work and sharing knowledge openly.

Nice to have

  • Experience with commit, drawdown and burst contract models, or cloud marketplace billing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Working knowledge of usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606).
  • Experience with system migrations or parallel runs for billing or ERP platforms.

title: Sr. Manager, Payroll
descriptionHtml:
GAQ128R86

Mission

Databricks is looking for a Senior Manager, Payroll to own end-to-end payroll delivery for the Europe region. This is a hands-on leadership role — you will run the operations, lead the team, own the compliance, and be the subject matter expert the business turns to when it matters.

You will sit within the Global Payroll function, reporting directly to the Director, Global Payroll Operations, contributing to global strategy, cross-regional alignment, and function-wide initiatives beyond your direct remit.

You will manage a team of two to five payroll professionals and be accountable for accurate, timely, and compliant payroll for a fast-scaling workforce.

This is not a coordinator role with a manager title. We need someone who has been in the engine room, knows what good looks like, and can build it here.

Individual will not be ‘back office’ this is a business facing role and enhancing employee experience and stakeholder management is key. 

The impact you will have:

Payroll Operations

  • Own the full payroll cycle, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and a clean audit trail on every run
  • Manage the payroll calendar, cut-off deadlines, and coordination with HR and Finance to ensure data integrity from hire to final pay
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for payroll discrepancies, employee queries, and operational issues — resolving with speed and precision
  • Drive continuous improvement across payroll processes, reducing manual effort and increasing controls without sacrificing responsiveness
  • Drive high performance from payroll vendors.

Technology & Systems

  • Work with our Payroll GPO and Leadership team to build Data and AI enabled payroll operations
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual reconciliation and improve data accuracy across the payroll tech stack

Tax Compliance  

  • Good understanding of requirements outside the payslip (such as PSA and STBV in UK) and able to input and work with relevant teams to ensure compliance. 

Equity & Supplemental Compensation

  • Manage payroll processing and tax withholding for RSU vesting events, including coordination with Stock Administration on vest schedules, sell-to-cover mechanics, and supplemental withholding rates
  • Partner with Legal and Tax on equity income sourcing and reporting obligations on equity-derived income
  • Reconcile equity payroll data to stock admin records each quarter with zero tolerance for mismatch

Team Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and performance-manage a team of payroll professionals — setting clear expectations, managing workload, and building capability
  • Expected to take a broader leadership role across the Global Payroll team as a senior leader within it. 
  • Create a team culture where accuracy is non-negotiable, deadlines are owned not managed around, and problems surface early
  • Build redundancy and cross-training so the function is never single-threaded 
  • Coach the team on technical depth — tax law, equity mechanics, compliance — so they grow into the next generation of payroll leaders

Controls, Audit & Governance

  • Design and maintain SOX-compliant payroll controls, including segregation of duties, approval workflows, and exception reporting
  • Lead payroll's response to internal and external audits — preparing documentation, managing timelines, and closing findings without repeat
  • Maintain payroll policy documentation and desktop procedures, updated with every legislative or system change
  • Produce monthly payroll metrics and variance analysis for Finance and HR leadership

What we look for:

  • 8+ years of hands-on payroll experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing a team
  • Deep working knowledge of European Payrolls 
  • Proven experience managing RSU and equity payroll — from vest event processing through reconciliation
  • Strong command of payroll reconciliation, general ledger mapping, and accrual processes
  • Experience leading teams of four or more people — you know how to delegate, develop, and hold people accountable
  • Excellent business stakeholder management skills - comms and employee experience focus

title: Sr. Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
CSQ128R178

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the entire non-technical lifecycle of an FDE engagement.

You will partner with our Account Executives to build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and, most importantly, scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing.

This role requires a rare mix of C-suite gravitas, deep product-style thinking, and a hands-on, get it done execution mindset.

You will report to the Director, Forward Deployed Engineering.

The impact you will have:

  • C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value (($M + Problems), and define the pilot (MVP, success criteria, timeline).
  • End-to-End Product Ownership: Act as the CEO of the project by authoring the PRD, prioritizing the engineering backlog, relentlessly managing scope, and acting as the primary hands-on QA tester.
  • Agile Project Execution & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team via an agile process, manage all stakeholder communications from the C-suite to individual engineers, and act as the escalation manager to unblock all technical or political issues.
  • Solution Launch & Landing: Own the Day 0 launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value.
  • Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement.

What we look for:

  • Executive Presence & Communication: A Trusted Advisor with C-suite gravitas and superb communication skills. You are opinionated, humble, and can build rapport and drive decisions in days, not weeks.
  • Product & Strategy Mindset: A Product Thinker and Systems Thinker who can perform a SWOT analysis, understand a competitive landscape, and define what to build and why.
  • Relentless Execution: An Execution Driver with a Hands-On mentality. You are relentless, an expert at escalation, and willing to do the unglamorous work to get the project done.
  • Ideal Experience: 2+ years as a Deployment Strategist OR 2+ years at a high-growth startup in a builder or founder capacity. (Alternatively: 5+ years in a senior, client-facing product or delivery role at a top-tier tech company or consultancy).
  • Proven Skills: Demonstrated experience in value-based scoping (TCO/ROI), managing agile software projects, writing PRDs, and the ability/interest to travel up to 50%.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, CustomerLake (ML/LLM)
descriptionHtml:
P-1607

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best Data Intelligence Platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

As one of the first engineers in the NYC Engineering office, you'll join a small, nimble team building new products from the ground up. We're building CustomerLake, the Customer Data Platform on Databricks, to bring enterprise-grade ML and AI personalization to every company whose data already lives on Databricks. The best B2C and B2B brands have historically relied on in-house ML/AI teams to power personalization, recommendations, churn and lifetime-value modeling, and audience targeting. Our goal is to deliver that same capability to companies that don't have an in-house team but already have their data in order on Databricks. This is a true 0-to-1 environment, combining the excitement of a startup with the resources of a tech leader like Databricks.

The impact you'll have:

  • Evaluate ML and LLM approaches for CustomerLake's personalization use cases, push the models and algorithms forward, and continuously improve quality over time
  • Go deep on how models behave in production: inspect individual traces, understand how the models reason, and tune and improve from there
  • Build the platform and evaluation framework that let CustomerLake customers optimize for real business value such as purchases, retention, and product usage, not vanity metrics like email opens and clicks
  • Push the team toward new directions and novel methods worth tackling, not just optimizing what already exists
  • Partner closely with product management, engineering, and design to turn ambiguous customer problems into scalable, trustworthy solutions
  • Set the technical foundation and best practices for our ML/AI personalization work as we grow this into several roles across our products over the next 1-2 years

What we look for:

  • 10+ years of engineering experience, with a strong foundation across the full loop of shipping and improving ML/AI products
  • Hands-on experience building and evaluating ML models and/or LLM systems for real product or business use cases; your understanding is practical, not purely academic, and you can make models work well inside a product
  • Experience with personalization based on customer behavior (ideal) or transactions (acceptable), such as recommendations, targeting, churn, or lifetime-value modeling
  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch), with hands-on experience in model evaluation and monitoring AI quality in production
  • Familiarity with LLMs and generative AI, including techniques like retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt design, fine-tuning, and evaluation
  • A demonstrated product mindset, with the ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into scrappy MVPs and iterate quickly based on data and user feedback
  • High ownership and bias for action in 0-to-1 environments: comfortable making pragmatic trade-offs, operating with incomplete information, and driving projects from idea through launch and adoption

Nice to have:

  • Experience in martech, ideally a go-to-market or business use case with an analytical (rather than purely transactional) angle
  • An academic or research background that can help us innovate and develop novel methods

title: Sr. Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
P-1626

Senior Product Designer

At Databricks, we design tools that make complex data and AI workflows intuitive and powerful. Our mission is to simplify how data is connected, understood, and activated so organizations can turn information into business outcomes. Designers at Databricks combine strong visual craft with systems thinking. They shape products used by some of the most advanced data teams in the world, and increasingly by the business users and AI agents working alongside them.

We're hiring Product Designers to join our design team and own design for an area of the Databricks Platform. Teams span the platform, from data engineering and analytics to databases, apps, and AI agents. We match each designer to the area where their skills and interests will have the most impact. You'll design for both technical and business users of data, making powerful capabilities feel clear, controllable, and trustworthy for enterprise customers.

The impact you will have

  • Own your area end to end. Sharpen the problem, set the design direction, and carry the work from framing and interaction models through visual polish and shipped detail.
  • Set the quality bar. Make the critical design decisions in your area, review work from designers, PM, engineering, and AI tools, and have the hands-on skill to improve it yourself.
  • Advocate with evidence. Stay in regular contact with customers, choose research methods that fit the decision, and turn research into insights others can act on.
  • Show the experience got better. Define what success looks like for the key tasks users need to get done, and show the improvement through usability testing, research, and how people actually use what shipped.
  • Influence through the work. Move product and engineering decisions with prototypes, keep design reviews focused, and communicate clearly in writing and in person.
  • Prototype to explore and align. Use interactive prototypes as a primary thinking tool to explore ambiguous problems, reduce risk, and align the team on a direction.
  • Design directly in the codebase with coding agents. Use AI coding agents to ship well-scoped design changes alongside engineers, rather than handing off static mocks.
  • Define reusable UX principles. Create interaction patterns and frameworks other teams reuse, and drive consistency through a strong, cross-platform design system.
  • Raise the level of critique. Give and invite high-quality feedback, and help make clear decisions together with product and engineering.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of product design work experience.
  • A bachelor's or master's degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction, or a related field.
  • A portfolio demonstrating your end-to-end design process, from inception to production.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large and complex design projects and balance the needs of diverse stakeholders.
  • A systems thinker who has the vision to design the big picture, and the tactical ability to break it down so that engineering can succeed in building it incrementally.
  • A deep understanding of business goals, customer needs, emerging AI capabilities, and the evolving data and technology landscape.
  • Self-directed and comfortable in ambiguity. You help shape product direction when the path isn't defined.
  • Beautiful visual and interaction work rooted in a data-driven, well-researched UX process.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing developer tools, data/analytics products, AI/ML products, or enterprise software.
  • Experience designing products that bridge the gap between technical and business users.
  • The strongest candidates have demonstrated experience using modern development and AI-assisted coding tools to prototype ideas, understand implementation tradeoffs, and collaborate deeply with engineering teams.

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping enterprises that build ML models and AI agents deliver high-quality AI to production fast. Our team builds the MLOps and LLMOps platform that millions of AI developers and ML practitioners use to track model training experiments, manage model registry, observe and evaluate AI agents. title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications
descriptionHtml:
Senior Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications

Enterprise Platform Group · Commercialization (Quote-to-Cash) · Mountain View, CA

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the Agentic Applications team, you will be the hands-on technical lead for how Databricks quotes, orders, bills and recognizes revenue. Your core function is to build bespoke first-party, agents-first applications built on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will own the technical architecture end to end, from quote to cash. You will design agents that work reliably inside revenue-critical workflows, set the engineering standards the team builds on, and make sure every agent-assisted decision can be observed, audited and trusted by Finance, Deal Desk and Sales.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management role. You will write code, review designs, and be the most senior technical voice in a domain that touches every dollar Databricks books.

The impact you'll have

  • Own the agentic architecture for Quote-to-Cash. Define and lead the target technical architecture across Configure-Price-Quote, deal management, ordering, subscriptions, investments, billing and revenue recognition. Drive the move from vendor-configured workflows to first-party, AI-native applications built on Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Unity Catalog and Mosaic AI.
  • Build production agents that sellers and Deal Desk trust. Design and ship LLM-powered agents for deal guidance, quote generation and summarization, multi-option proposals, approval insights, and pricing and discount recommendations. Work directly with sales, Deal Desk and Finance to define what "good" looks like for each workflow.
  • Make agent reliability a core system property. Own the eval and quality system for this domain: per-workflow quality criteria, offline eval suites, LLM-as-judge and human-labeled benchmarks, behavioral regression testing in CI/CD, online tracing, and feedback loops that improve agents based on what users approve, edit and reject.
  • Design human-in-the-loop controls for revenue-critical decisions. Build the separation between what an agent proposes and what gets committed, plus diff-based review, approval routing, audit logging, and policy guardrails. Together these decide when an agent can act on its own and when a person has to approve, especially for pricing, discounting, contract terms and order creation.
  • Treat systems of record as agent tools. Architect tool-calling and MCP-style interfaces that give agents governed, run-time access to pricing, product catalog, order, contract, subscription and billing data. Follow single-source-of-truth principles across CRM, ERP and billing systems.
  • Protect financial integrity at scale. Make sure agent-assisted quoting and ordering produce accurate, compliance-grade outputs downstream: order validation, billing, invoicing and revenue recognition, where errors directly affect financial reporting.
  • Lead the migration path. Act as the bridge between today's production quoting platform and the target agentic architecture. Sequence the migration so the business keeps scaling without disruption, and decide what to retire, rebuild or wrap.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Lead architecture reviews, establish design patterns for agents (orchestration, memory, retrieval, tool use, multi-agent coordination), and mentor senior and mid-level engineers on production-grade agentic engineering.
  • Earn cross-functional credibility. Partner with Finance, Deal Desk, Sales Ops, Legal and the broader Platform engineering org. Turn complex commercial processes into clear technical roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.

What we look for

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership and ownership of large-scale production systems.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building and running LLM-powered or agentic applications in production, such as agents, RAG pipelines, tool use, multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, DSPy or equivalent), and evaluation frameworks for generative outputs.
  • Strong backend and distributed-systems skills: API and service design, data modeling, idempotency, consistency and transactional integrity, and observability.
  • Proven experience designing human-in-the-loop systems: approval workflows, review interfaces, audit trails, and guardrails for probabilistic systems operating in regulated or high-stakes domains.
  • Experience leading technical architecture for complex business domains, ideally Quote-to-Cash, Order-to-Revenue, billing, pricing or other revenue-critical enterprise systems.
  • Full-stack fluency. You are comfortable across modern web frameworks (React/TypeScript), backend services (Python, Java, Scala or Go), and data platforms.
  • Ability to work directly with non-engineering stakeholders and turn ambiguous business workflows into clear agent and system architecture.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical execution across a team, without relying on positional authority.

Nice to have

  • Domain experience with CPQ, deal management, subscription management, or revenue recognition in a high-growth SaaS or consumption-based business.
  • Experience building first-party applications on top of, or as replacements for, enterprise SaaS platforms (e.g., Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud, NetSuite, Zuora). Platform-specific configuration expertise is a plus but not a requirement.
  • Experience with the Databricks platform (Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Unity Catalog, Mosaic AI Agent Framework, MLflow tracing and evaluation).
  • Familiarity with SOX controls, audit requirements, and financial-systems compliance.

About the role

Databricks Learning & Enablement trains customers, partners, and Databricks employees on the Data Intelligence Platform. As a Staff Technical Instructor, you deliver our most strategic technical training and set the instructional quality bar for a global community of instructors and training partners. You partner with curriculum, operations, and account teams to translate real-world delivery experience into better courses, stronger instructors, and measurable learner outcomes.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Global Delivery Excellence. You are a thought partner to Senior Director+ stakeholders on training delivery.

What you will do

  1. Lead associate- and professional-level instructor-led training across most of the Databricks catalog, virtual and in person, including tailored programs for strategic customers and large-scale events such as Data + AI Summit.
  2. Partner with curriculum teams on new course development and curriculum revamps so content reflects real delivery needs.
  3. Mentor Databricks Certified Instructors training partner instructors globally with timely, candid, actionable feedback.
  4. Use CSAT, NPS, and skill-progression data to identify and implement improvements in learner outcomes, instructor operations, tooling, and scheduling.
  5. Advise delivery leadership and account-facing teams on training plans, priorities, and emerging trends.
  6. Build AI-based tools to evolve training delivery readiness and in-class experiences.

What we look for

  • Deep subject-matter expertise in at least one Databricks domain: Data Engineering, Data Analysis, Machine Learning, or Generative AI
  • Most Databricks certifications completed, at both associate and professional levels
  • Hands-on proficiency with the Databricks workspace, Databricks SQL, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Jobs, Git folders, and Unity Catalog
  • A track record of influencing training products, delivery processes, or tooling beyond your own classroom
  • Experience mentoring and tailoring your coaching style to the individual
  • Comfort presenting to and advising senior technical and business stakeholders
  • Continuous study of industry trends and active investment in depth across additional technical domains

title: Director of Engineering - Databricks Commercialization & Marketplace
descriptionHtml:
Director of Engineering - Databricks Commercialization & Marketplace 

P-1630

About the role

Every product Databricks ships has to be priced, contracted, rated and billed before it can earn a dollar. The Money organization builds the systems that make this happen, at hyperscaler scale and across every major cloud. We built the world's only cross-cloud integrated rating engine in-house, and it now rates billions of dollars in revenue. Our next goal is bigger: a fully automated, zero-touch order-to-cash flow where the platform is the source of truth for accounts, contracts and subscriptions, and Month End Close needs little or no human intervention.

As Director of Engineering, you will lead the engineering organization that owns this commercial engine from start to finish. You will set the product and technology strategy for how Databricks makes money. You will be the engineering voice Finance, Product and GTM leaders turn to for strategic decisions. You will also build the leadership bench that lets the organization keep scaling.

Speed is critical. Databricks keeps inventing new ways to sell: commit and pay-as-you-go, marketplaces, conditional benefits, strategic partnerships and new clouds and regions. The commerce engine either makes each of these fast and safe to launch, or it becomes the bottleneck. You will make sure it is the former.

What you'll own

The org covers six commercial domains:

  • Pricing configuration: SKUs, multipliers, price-change processes, deal desk and discounting
  • Orders and contracts: from negotiated quote to order to signed customer contract
  • Subscriptions: commit, pay-as-you-go and proof-of-concept subscriptions, plus how contracts are tied to payment methods
  • Rating: applying each customer's negotiated price, discounts and conditional benefits to ingested usage to compute the bill
  • Billing: commit drawdown, invoicing, Month End Close and related financial processes
  • Marketplace: third-party data and solutions, available seamlessly to Databricks customers

The impact you'll have

  • Set and communicate the vision. Write the multi-year product and technology strategy for the commerce engine, toward a zero-touch order-to-cash flow and a next-generation billing architecture. Present it clearly to executives, Finance and Product leaders, so that strategy and architecture decisions come to you by default.
  • Own business outcomes across orgs, not just your team's part. Revenue-critical programs routinely span 100+ people across Finance, Product, IT, Accounts and GTM. You will own the full outcome: dependency plans with clear owners, timelines, quality bars and escalation triggers, raised early in leadership forums so cross-org risks don't become executive surprises.
  • Make commercialization a platform capability. Build reusable building blocks (credits, commits, conditional benefits, marketplace and partner billing) so that new pricing models and routes to market ship in weeks, not quarters.
  • Treat foundations as seriously as features. Hold reliability, correctness, SOX and compliance readiness, security, cost visibility and operational load to the same standard as product launches. Billing errors should be structurally impossible, operational work should grow more slowly than revenue, and postmortems should actually lead to change.
  • Partner deeply with Business & Finance. Turn accounting, close and compliance requirements into engineering design. Keep improving the Month End Close timeline and audit readiness, and earn the trust of Technical Accounting, Revenue Ops and Strategy & Execution leaders.
  • Build a team of leaders. Grow the organization from one with a large group of direct-report engineers to one led by strong engineering managers and tech-lead managers, with clear subteams, domain boundaries and named owners. Coach managers to be great people leaders, give specific feedback and career plans, and recognize high-performing teams publicly.
  • Hire like a founder. Act as the hiring owner for the Money Bellevue site. Source and close senior engineering and management talent, put the company first when placing hires across Money teams, and help raise the Databricks engineering hiring bar.

What we're looking for

  • 12+ years in software engineering, including 6+ years leading engineering organizations and managing managers, ideally in billing, payments, commerce, fintech or other systems where errors directly cost revenue or create regulatory exposure
  • A track record of delivering large, revenue-critical, cross-functional programs (for example, replacing a billing or rating system, migrating a source of truth, or automating order-to-cash) on time and with high quality
  • Technical depth in distributed systems and large-scale data pipelines. You can discuss correctness, idempotency, reconciliation and data lineage with tech leads, and you know when to coach and when to decide.
  • Fluency in order-to-cash and finance concepts: pricing and discounting, contracts, revenue recognition, invoicing, month-end close, SOX controls. You have earned trust as a partner to Finance and Accounting leaders.
  • Strong product judgment: you can spot gaps in the commercial platform, shape requirements with Product, and make build-versus-buy decisions that pay off over time
  • Clear, confident communication of strategy to executives, plus the ability to influence peers in Product, Finance, IT and GTM without direct authority
  • Experience scaling an organization quickly while keeping a high hiring bar, developing strong leaders and engineers, and keeping them engaged on internal platform work
  • BS in Computer Science or a related field; MS preferred. Experience with Kafka, Apache Spark, Delta Lake or cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.

Why this role

You will run the engine behind the revenue of one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world. The problems involve hard distributed-systems correctness at scale, high financial and compliance stakes, and a direct, visible link to company growth. You'll lead an established, high-trust team with a strong delivery record and help shape what the next generation of the commerce engine looks like.

title: Engineering Manager - Developer Ecosystem
descriptionHtml:
RDQ427R369

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.

The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.

The impact you will have:

  • Lead and grow the team: Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.
  • Make agentic development the default path: Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.
  • Own the strategy and roadmap: Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.
  • Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence: Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.
  • Treat backward compatibility as a product feature: Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.
  • Lead across the platform: Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Make the whole toolchain feel like one product.

What we look for:

  • 3+ years managing software engineering teams, and 8+ years of software engineering experience overall.
  • A track record of building and shipping developer tools or platforms used by many external developers or internal teams, such as infrastructure-as-code, deployment or CI/CD systems, CLIs, SDKs, or internal developer platforms.
  • A deep understanding of declarative systems and deployment workflows: plan/apply, state management, drift and reconciliation, environment promotion, GitOps.
  • Enough technical depth to engage on architecture and trade-offs with senior and staff engineers, and to hold a high-quality bar for public, versioned interfaces.
  • Experience leading teams through ambiguity, with competing priorities from customers, partners and platform dependencies, and making clear calls.
  • Strong product sense and a customer-first mindset. You enjoy talking to developers, reading their issues, and turning feedback into roadmap.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executives, partner teams and an external developer community.

Stand-out experience:

  • Built or led teams on infrastructure-as-code or deployment platforms, e.g. Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK / CloudFormation, Kubernetes controllers, Argo CD / Flux / Helm, or Vercel / Netlify-style deploy platforms.
  • Managed an open-source developer tool with an active community and a frequent release cadence.
  • Shipped developer workflows for AI coding agents (CLI-first tooling, agent skills, MCP), or AI-assisted authoring.

title: Sr. Research Scientist - Agent Flywheel
descriptionHtml:
Sr. Research Scientist - Agent Flywheel

P-1213

Company Description

At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI platform so our customers can focus on the high-value challenges that are central to their own missions.

The Databricks AI Research organization is pushing the frontier of next-generation enterprise AI. We believe a company's data is its greatest competitive advantage, and we're building the models and agents that unlock it. Our work spans the full stack, from model training to advanced multi-agent systems.

Job Description

As a Research Scientist on the Agent Flywheel team, you will build the context layer for recursive self-improvement and autofix loops for agents: turning raw production session traces from Databricks’ data agents into online signals agents can optimize against. You will research how to convert messy, real customer interactions into deterministic metrics, calibrated LLM judges, and failure clusters, and close the loop so those signals drive training and agent improvement. 

You will join a collaborative team of researchers with diverse backgrounds and encode your findings into products our customers rely on. 

The impact you will have

  • Turn raw production session traces from Genie Code and Genie One into online signals agents can optimize against.
  • Train and calibrate LLM judges so model feedback becomes reliable, repeatable signal, including calibration against expert human ratings.
  • Convert multi-turn agent trajectories into datasets and reward signals for post-training, closing the loop between production signals, evaluation, and agent improvement.
  • Design benchmarks and RL environments from real customer workloads that probe long-horizon, tool-using agent behavior.
  • Advance evaluation research: online evals on live traffic, automated raters, verifiable rewards, and measurement that keeps pace with agents that act.
  • Keep up with the latest developments in deep learning and create new techniques that go beyond the state of the art.

What we look for

  • Expertise in debugging and diagnosing failures in complex, stochastic, multi-component systems
  • Deep instinct for designing metrics and evals that track what actually matters, and questioning noisy, sparse, or biased signals
  • Experimental rigor and causal thinking, from offline ablations to online experiments
  • A drive to turn measurement into improvement: closing the loop from signals to changes that move the numbers
  • Solid AI research and software engineering skills
  • Strong communication skills and excitement to work on a small, fast-paced team
  • A drive to get your work into the hands of real users

Nice to have

  • Experience with agent systems, such as coding agents, long-horizon tool-using agents, or building evaluation environments
  • A track record of novel research on learning from feedback, such as post-training, RLHF, or reward modeling

title: Staff Software Engineer - Threat and Abuse Defense
descriptionHtml:
P-211

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

The Threat and Abuse Defense team protects Databricks, its customers, and its employees from attackers and misuse of the product. Our mission is to deter, detect, and disrupt threats and abuse before they cause business-impacting incidents. Engineers on this team build and operate a real-time, highly-scalable decision platform that includes inline enforcement at critical chokepoints, shared infrastructure for feature stores and entity graphs, machine learning model scoring, and an agent framework for triaging and investigating threats. We measure our impact through quantifiable metrics and leverage frontier AI to ensure the trust and safety of the Databricks platform.

title: Sr. Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
CSQ128R208

PLEASE NOTE: Due to federal contract requirements and client site access obligations, U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a U.S. government secret clearance are required to access classified information. Candidates with an active Secret or higher clearance are strongly encouraged to apply.

About Databricks: At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers and deeply customer-obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to solve hard technical challenges, from designing modern application interfaces to architecting highly available, distributed systems at massive scale. And we're only getting started.

The Role:As a Senior Staff Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will be the principal technical authority working with our largest and most complex federal government customers to solve their most critical software, data, and AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will define the technical vision, pioneer novel system architectures, and lead the implementation of enterprise-scale applications spanning backend infrastructure, API integration, and AI-powered product development.

At the Senior Staff level, you are a force multiplier. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering leadership, product management, and developer relations. You will act as a trusted advisor to technical executives at customer organizations, integrating deeply with client codebases and systems while mentoring other FDEs and engineering teams. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for elite builders and technical strategists who thrive at the intersection of software engineering, distributed systems, and massive business impact.

Please note: this role is hybrid and has a requirement to travel to customer locations 20-25% of the time.

The impact you will have:

  • Strategic Solution Leadership: Lead the most complex and high-stakes customer technical projects. Pioneer and build robust, first-of-their-kind reference architectures, massive-scale custom enterprise applications, and seamless integrations with cutting-edge AI/ML models.
  • Enterprise Transformation: Drive executive-level technical strategy as strategic customers implement transformational software projects. Oversee the end-to-end design, build, and deployment of industry-leading, data-intensive AI applications across highly matrixed federal organizations.
  • Visionary Guidance: Act as a trusted technical advisor to C-suite and VP-level customer stakeholders. Guide technical leadership on software architecture, system design, and platform adoption, successfully steering their long-term Databricks development strategy.
  • Architectural Pioneer: Own and define software architecture decisions for systems with unprecedented scale or security requirements. Ensure applications are secure, highly available, scalable, and set the standard for modern software engineering and Databricks best practices globally.
  • Deliver Technical Excellence: Orchestrate multi-team, multi-quarter technical engagements. Align Databricks technical teams, Architects, and Customer engineering leadership to ensure flawless delivery of mission-critical software components.
  • Product Engineering Influence: Partner heavily with Databricks Core Engineering and Product leadership. Translate complex, edge-case developer challenges from the field into actionable product roadmap initiatives, APIs, and platform enhancements.
  • Customer Immersion & Navigation: Embed with customer engineering teams, navigating highly complex organizational structures to deeply understand entrenched software challenges and deliver code-level, systemic impact.
  • Ecosystem Multiplication: Act as a technical multiplier. Pioneer and open-source massive-scale code accelerators, global development frameworks, and engineering best practices that scale impact across all federal accounts and elevate the entire FDE organization.

What We're Looking For:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, backend development, or distributed systems engineering, with a proven track record of architectural leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Applied Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent relevant years of experience in an Engineering function.
  • Expert-level proficiency writing scalable production code in Python, Scala, Java, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript, and architecting solutions using modern application frameworks.
  • Deep, authoritative multi-cloud architectural expertise (AWS, Azure, GCP) with the ability to design cross-cloud or hybrid distributed systems.
  • Advanced experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and deep internal knowledge of the Spark runtime engine, optimization, and scaling.
  • Mastery of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform) for complex, high-security production deployments.
  • Expert knowledge of MLOps, deploying custom ML/AI models, and integrating LLMs and AI APIs into massive-scale production environments.
  • Proven ability to design and deploy performant, end-to-end software architectures that combine backend services, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces with zero-downtime requirements.
  • Extensive experience steering complex technical project delivery—managing massive scope, driving agile engineering teams, and translating ambiguous business requirements into actionable, enterprise-grade software solutions.
  • Exceptional technical documentation, system white-boarding, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex distributed systems to both elite engineers and non-technical executives.
  • Deep experience working with massive enterprise or federal clients, managing conflicts, and driving consensus across a highly diverse and senior stakeholder range.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, continuously explore new development tools, and push the boundaries of what is possible with Databricks-based solutions.
  • Travel to customers 20-25% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, backend development, and building mission-critical, enterprise-level distributed systems.
  • Recognized industry thought leadership (e.g., published papers, tech blog posts, open-source maintainer status, or conference speaking experience).
  • Experience serving on an enterprise architecture board or steering committee.
  • Certification in a Databricks-specific domain.

FEQ427R145

As anInfrastructure & AI Platform Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, guiding enterprise customers through the architecture, cloud infrastructure, and AI deployment patterns of their Databricks Platform on Microsoft Azure. You combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to position Databricks as the foundation of your customers’ data and AI strategy.

This role can be remote.

The impact you will have

  • Guide strategic customers through the full lifecycle of Databricks on Azure, including platform administration, from initial architectural design to production deployment
  • Architect and scale compute/networking infrastructure designed specifically for AI workloads, enterprise LLM deployments, and high-performance GenAI applications built on Databricks
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in core areas such as Microsoft Azure infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), cloud networking, and identity management
  • Drive technical wins in competitive scenarios by demonstrating Databricks’ differentiation through custom-built solutions
  • Orchestrate cross-functional resources (DSAs, SAs, SSAs, Partners) to deliver comprehensive solutions for complex customer needs
  • Influence product direction by providing structured feedback on customer requirements and competitive gaps

What We Look For

  • 6+ years in solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role
  • Hands-on experience architecting underlying cloud infrastructure for AI/ML execution—including accelerator configuration (GPUs/TPUs), scalable model serving infrastructure, vectorized data retrieval, and balancing cloud performance vs. cost for large-scale AI workloads
  • Advanced expertise across the following areas:
    • Security & Identity: Azure security controls, platform/network/data security, encryption, vulnerability management, compliance, and identity protocols (Microsoft Entra ID / SCIM, OAuth, SAML, Federation)
    • Networking & Deployments: Azure enterprise networking (VNet peering, ExpressRoute, Private Link), network routing, performance optimization, and large-scale deployment management
    • Platform Administration: High availability, disaster recovery, cluster orchestration, observability (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics), and Azure cost management
    • Infrastructure Automation (InfraOps): Hands-on automation using IaC tools (e.g., Terraform, Bicep, ARM) to build, maintain, and scale complex Azure environments
  • Strong coding proficiency in Python and SQL — you must demonstrate live coding, debugging, and solution-building skills
  • Deep expertise in distributed data systems architecture: designing scalable pipelines, streaming architectures, lakehouse patterns, and cloud-native data platforms
  • Proficient on the Databricks Platform (or demonstrated ability to achieve proficiency rapidly) with a developing technical specialization in one area (e.g., real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, migrations)
  • Proven ability to lead architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders — whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off analysis
  • Track record of driving platform adoption and consumption growth within accounts
  • Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex architectures into business value for both technical and executive audiences
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% as needed

Nice to Have

  • Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, Platform)
  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer)
  • Experience with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) — understanding the landscape you'll position against
  • Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider

Interview Process

Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design and Architecture Interview → Live Coding Assessment → Presentation → Reference Check

Pay Range Transparency

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles.  Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here.

Local Pay Range$180,000—$247,500 USD

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
